title: Everyday Phrases — A Counselling Session
scene_zh: 心理諮商 · 情境對話
title_quote: Is this your first time here?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🌿 實用「心理諮商」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Counselling Session
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「心理諮商」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是一場平靜的初次會談：在等候室填表格、簽名、坐進寬椅子，說這十一天過得怎麼樣、夜裡睡不好、工作壓力大到肩膀緊，然後一起學三個慢呼吸（吸四下、吐六下），在卡片上用鉛筆寫下三件小事，約好下週二同一時間，最後走出門口，外面天氣很好，慢慢走回家。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含描述睡眠與身體感覺、說工作壓力、約下次時間、溫和地回答提問。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'A Counselling Session' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is one calm first meeting: filling in the form in the waiting room, signing it, sitting in the wide chair, talking about the last eleven days, sleeping badly, work pressure that tightens the shoulders, then learning three slow breaths (in for four, out for six), writing three small things on a card in pencil, fixing the same time next Tuesday, and walking out into really good weather on the way home. 800 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this your first time here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs jɔr fɜrst taɪm hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這是你的第一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the hallway felt very long.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈhɔlweɪ fɛlt ˈvɛri lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，那段走廊走起來特別長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find the building easily?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju faɪnd ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈizəli?/
dialogue.zh: 你找到這棟樓還順利嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus stopped right outside the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs stɑpt raɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 公車正好停在大門外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you the lady with the blue folder?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ðə ˈleɪdi wɪð ðə blu ˈfoʊldər?/
dialogue.zh: 拿藍色資料夾的這位是你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is my folder, yes, the blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈfoʊldər jɛs ðə blu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那是我那份，對，藍色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please take a seat in the wide chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz teɪk ə sit ɪn ðə waɪd ʧɛr./
dialogue.zh: 請坐到那張寬一點的椅子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, my hands are cold today.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju maɪ hændz ɑr koʊld təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我今天雙手冷冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I hold the clipboard for you now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hoʊld ðə ˈklɪpˌbɔrd fɔr ju naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在幫你扶著表格板可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please, the screw is a bit loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ðə skru ɪz ə bɪt lus./
dialogue.zh: 好，上面那顆螺絲有點鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pen writes but slowly on this page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɛn raɪts bʌt ˈsloʊli ɑn ðɪs peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 這枝筆在這一頁上寫得慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will press a little harder now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl prɛs ə ˈlɪtəl ˈhɑrdər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那我把筆壓稍微重一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We start with your name on the top line.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stɑrt wɪð jɔr neɪm ɑn ðə tɑp laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我們從最上面那行名字開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My name is Wei, and I came alone today.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz weɪ ænd aɪ keɪm əˈloʊn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我姓魏，今天獨自過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And how should I write your given name?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd haʊ ʃʊd aɪ raɪt jɔr ˈɡɪvən neɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 那名字的部分我該怎麼寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just Su, with two letters only.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst su wɪð tu ˈlɛtərz ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 就一個素字，兩個字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the paper too far from your hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈpeɪpər tu fɑr frʌm jɔr hænd?/
dialogue.zh: 紙離你的手會不會太遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, I can reach it with one move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst aɪ kæn riʧ ɪt wɪð wʌn muv./
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，我把紙拉近一點就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a glass of water on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ɡlæs əv ˈwɔtər ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 桌上放著一杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I would like a small sip a bit later.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk ə smɔl sɪp ə bɪt ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 等一下我想小口喝一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This form asks about your daily routine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fɔrm æskz əˈbaʊt jɔr ˈdeɪli ruˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 這張表格會問你每天的作息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Routine is loose now, mornings and nights blur.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruˈtin ɪz lus naʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋz ænd naɪts blɜr./
dialogue.zh: 作息現在很鬆，早上跟晚上糊在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sleep by clock time or by feel?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju slip baɪ klɑk taɪm ɔr baɪ fil?/
dialogue.zh: 你是按鐘點睡，還是依感覺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By feel, and most nights it comes late.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ fil ænd moʊst naɪts ɪt kʌmz leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 靠感覺，多數夜晚都睡得很晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many boxes did you mark on page two?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɑksɪz dɪd ju mɑrk ɑn peɪdʒ tu?/
dialogue.zh: 第二頁你總共勾了幾個格子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only three, and I left one box empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli θri ænd aɪ lɛft wʌn bɑks ˈɛmpi./
dialogue.zh: 只勾三個，有一個小格我留空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which box was the hard one to choose?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪʧ bɑks wʌz ðə hɑrd wʌn tu ʧuz?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一格最不好選？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one that asks how tired I feel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn ðæt æskz haʊ ˈtaɪərd aɪ fil./
dialogue.zh: 問我有多累的那一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tired is honest, so no box here is wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪərd ɪz ˈɑnɪst soʊ noʊ bɑks hɪr ɪz rɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 累是很誠實的答案，這裡沒有錯的格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will add one short line under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl æd wʌn ʃɔrt laɪn ˈʌndər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那我在下面補一行短句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This line is for your phone, the current one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs laɪn ɪz fɔr jɔr foʊn ðə ˈkɜrənt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這一行是填你現在的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The number changed since last spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnʌmbər ʧeɪndʒd sɪns læst sprɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 號碼從上個春天就換了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ring you or write to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi rɪŋ ju ɔr raɪt tu ju?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該打電話給你，還是傳訊息？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write first, the phone rings all day at work.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt fɜrst ðə foʊn rɪŋz ɔl deɪ æt wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 先傳訊息，上班時電話整天響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And who should we call if plans change?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd hu ʃʊd wi kɔl ɪf plænz ʧeɪndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果行程變了，我們該聯絡誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My sister, she keeps one at her place.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstər ʃi kips wʌn æt hɜr pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我姊，她那邊留了一把備用鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more small line, the paper asks your age.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr smɔl laɪn ðə ˈpeɪpər æskz jɔr eɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 還有一行小字，表格問年齡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty-four, and most days at a desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti fɔr ænd moʊst deɪz æt ə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 三十四歲，多數日子都在桌前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the last box wants a small signature.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə læst bɑks wɑnts ə smɔl ˈsɪɡnəʧər./
dialogue.zh: 最後一格要你簽個名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I sign it slow or in one stroke?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ saɪn ɪt sloʊ ɔr ɪn wʌn stroʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 要慢慢簽，還是一筆寫成？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any way is fine, this page stays with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni weɪ ɪz faɪn ðɪs peɪdʒ steɪz wɪð ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 怎麼寫都行，這一頁只有我們會看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With us, that phrase let me breathe again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ʌs ðæt freɪz lɛt mi brið əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那句只有我們會看，讓我又能呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the long hallway make you want to leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə lɔŋ ˈhɔlweɪ meɪk ju wɑnt tu liv?/
dialogue.zh: 剛才那段長走廊，有沒有讓你很想離開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but this chair is very quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl bʌt ðɪs ʧɛr ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 有一點，不過這張椅子很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet is the rule, not a promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət ɪz ðə rul nɑt ə ˈprɑmɪs./
dialogue.zh: 安靜是這裡的規矩，不是我給的保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clock ticks softly in the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk tɪks ˈsɔftli ɪn ðə ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 時鐘在角落輕輕地走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that ticking bother you right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt ˈtɪkɪŋ ˈbɑðər ju raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 那個滴答聲現在會吵到你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it keeps a slow and steady beat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt kips ə sloʊ ænd ˈstɛdi bit./
dialogue.zh: 不會，它保持很慢很穩的拍子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a blanket on the lower shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈblæŋkɪt ɑn ðə ˈloʊər ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 下面那層架子上有一條毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: May I take it over for my knees?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪk ɪt ˈoʊvər fɔr maɪ niz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以拿過來蓋膝蓋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, the shelf also holds a warm cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs ðə ʃɛlf ˈɔlsoʊ hoʊldz ə wɔrm kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 當然，架子上也有一個溫熱的杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm tea sounds better than plain water now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ti saʊndz ˈbɛtər ðæn pleɪn ˈwɔtər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在溫茶比白開水更合我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kettle lives behind that small brown door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɛtl lɪvz bɪˈhaɪnd ðæt smɔl braʊn dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 熱水壺在那扇棕色小門後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wait, my hands need warmth first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl weɪt maɪ hændz nid wɔrmθ fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我先等一下，手要先暖起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your folder holds one blank paper card inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈfoʊldər hoʊldz wʌn blæŋk ˈpeɪpər kɑrd ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 你的資料夾裡有一張空白紙卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was empty, so I kept it that way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz ˈɛmpi soʊ aɪ kɛpt ɪt ðæt weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 它原本是空的，我就讓它空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blank pages are welcome in this room.
dialogue.phonetic: /blæŋk ˈpeɪdʒɪz ɑr ˈwɛlkəm ɪn ðɪs rum./
dialogue.zh: 空白頁在這間屋子裡是受歡迎的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome is a strange word for me today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm ɪz ə streɪndʒ wɜrd fɔr mi təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 歡迎這個詞，對今天的我很陌生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We may fill only one line today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi meɪ fɪl ˈoʊnli wʌn laɪn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天我們只填一行也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line is small enough to try now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn ɪz smɔl ɪˈnʌf tu traɪ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 一行很小，小到現在就能試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp over us is warm but low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp ˈoʊvər ʌs ɪz wɔrm bʌt loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們頭上這盞燈很暖，但很暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low light suits a tired afternoon well.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ laɪt suts ə ˈtaɪərd ˌæftərˈnun wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 暗暗的光剛好配疲倦的下午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday, the ninth, and the rain outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ ðə naɪnθ ænd ðə reɪn ˌaʊtˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 星期二，九號，外面在下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain makes the waiting room feel softer.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn meɪks ðə ˈweɪtɪŋ rum fil ˈsɔftər./
dialogue.zh: 下雨讓等候室看起來柔軟一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You waited ten minutes in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈweɪtɪd tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɪn ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 你在走廊坐了十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I had the card and a folded paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæd ðə kɑrd ænd ə ˈfoʊldəd ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 我手上拿著紙卡和摺好的紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the desk lady give you a towel?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə dɛsk ˈleɪdi ɡɪv ju ə ˈtaʊəl?/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台有拿毛巾給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She did, and it smelled like clean cotton.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dɪd ænd ɪt smɛld laɪk klin ˈkɑtən./
dialogue.zh: 有，聞起來像剛洗過的棉布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cotton and paper are the smell here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑtən ænd ˈpeɪpər ɑr ðə smɛl hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 棉布跟紙的味道就是這裡的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plus a little dust on the shelf edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌs ə ˈlɪtəl dʌst ɑn ðə ʃɛlf ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 再加架子邊上的一點灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shelf has held forms for many years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf hæz hɛld fɔrms fɔr ˈmɛni jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 那層架子收表格收了很多年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many hands have rubbed that wood smooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛni hændz hæv rʌbd ðæt wʊd smuð./
dialogue.zh: 很多手把木頭磨得很亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smooth wood and quiet light do the work.
dialogue.phonetic: /smuð wʊd ænd ˈkwaɪət laɪt du ðə wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 亮的木頭和暗暗的光，那就是它的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The work of making a room feel safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɜrk əv ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə rum fil seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 它做的是讓這間屋子讓人安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe is a small step, not a claim.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf ɪz ə smɔl stɛp nɑt ə kleɪm./
dialogue.zh: 安心是一小步，不是承諾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small step fits the shoes I wear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl stɛp fɪts ðə ʃuz aɪ wɛr./
dialogue.zh: 一小步剛好合我這雙鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those shoes look wet from the morning rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz ʃuz lʊk wɛt frʌm ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那雙鞋被早上的雨弄濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are old, and they keep me moving slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr oʊld ænd ðeɪ kip mi ˈmuvɪŋ sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它們很舊，也讓我走得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moving slow is allowed in this hallway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmuvɪŋ sloʊ ɪz əˈlaʊd ɪn ðɪs ˈhɔlweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 走慢一點在這條走廊裡是被允許的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Allowed for the walk, but not for the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaʊd fɔr ðə wɔk bʌt nɑt fɔr ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 走路可以慢，坐在辦公桌就不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The desk can wait until this hour ends.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk kæn weɪt ʌnˈtɪl ðɪs ˈaʊər ɛndz./
dialogue.zh: 辦公桌可以等，等這個小時結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is kind, my bag feels heavy now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz kaɪnd maɪ bæɡ filz ˈhɛvi naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你好體貼，我的包現在很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take the bag to the chair hook?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪk ðə bæɡ tu ðə ʧɛr hʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 我把包掛到椅背的鉤子上好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, it holds my whole day inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ɪt hoʊldz maɪ hoʊl deɪ ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 好，那袋裡裝著我一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many notebooks in the bag today?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈnoʊtˌbɛks ɪn ðə bæɡ təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 今天包裡有幾本筆記？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three now, I added one for this room.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri naʊ aɪ ˈædɪd wʌn fɔr ðɪs rum./
dialogue.zh: 現在三本，我多了一本給這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That new notebook can stay closed today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt nju ˈnoʊtˌbʊk kæn steɪ kloʊzd təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那本新的今天可以不打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed is easier than writing a full page.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd ɪz ˈisɪər ðæn ˈraɪtɪŋ ə fʊl peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 不打開比寫滿一頁容易多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The form is only the first page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɔrm ɪz ˈoʊnli ðə fɜrst peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 表格不過是第一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First pages are thin ones, I believe that.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ˈpeɪdʒɪz ɑr θɪn wʌnz aɪ bɪˈliv ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 第一頁都很薄，這一點我相信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock says four, we have fifty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk sɛz fɔr wi hæv ˈfɪfti ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 鐘指四點，我們有五十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty minutes is one long cup of tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ˈmɪnɪts ɪz wʌn lɔŋ kʌp əv ti./
dialogue.zh: 五十分鐘像一杯泡很久的茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long cups are better than quick ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ kʌps ɑr ˈbɛtər ðæn kwɪk wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 泡久的茶比快喝的那種好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine stays half warm all the way here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn steɪz hæf wɔrm ɔl ðə weɪ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我這杯一路到這裡都只剩一半溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half warm suits a Tuesday afternoon well.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf wɔrm suts ə ˈtuzdeɪ ˌæftərˈnun wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 半溫剛好配週二的下午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Afternoon is my weak time, I keep it plain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæftərˈnun ɪz maɪ wik taɪm aɪ kip ɪt pleɪn./
dialogue.zh: 下午是我最弱的時段，我讓它很平淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plain days use few words, and that is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn deɪz juz fju wɜrdz ænd ðæt ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 平淡的日子話少，那樣也沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Few words today, more of them next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju wɜrdz təˈdeɪ mɔr əv ðɛm nɛkst wik./
dialogue.zh: 今天少說一點，下週再多加幾句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold it when you are ready, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ɪt wɛn ju ɑr ˈrɛdi noʊ rʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 你準備好了就摺起來，不用趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The form is folded, the card is mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɔrm ɪz ˈfoʊldəd ðə kɑrd ɪz maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 表格摺起來了，卡片歸我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the form is done, and now we talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə fɔrm ɪz dʌn ænd naʊ wi tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 表格填好了，現在輪到我們說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Talk is new, I usually write things down.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔk ɪz nju aɪ ˈjuʒuəli raɪt θɪŋz daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 說話對我還新，我平常都寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How have the last eleven days been?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ hæv ðə læst ɪˈlɛvən deɪz bɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 最近這十一天，你過得怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long in the day, thin in the evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ ɪn ðə deɪ θɪn ɪn ðə ˈivnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 白天很長，傍晚很虛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven days, you counted each one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən deɪz ju ˈkaʊntɪd iʧ wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 十一天，你真的每天都在數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven days, and two of them were weekends.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən deɪz ænd tu əv ðɛm wɜr ˈwikˌɛndz./
dialogue.zh: 十一天，其中有兩天是假日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weekends at home, who is there with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwikˌɛndz æt hoʊm hu ɪz ðɛr wɪð ju?/
dialogue.zh: 假日在家的時候，誰陪你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother calls, and my sister comes by.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðər kɔlz ænd maɪ ˈsɪstər kʌmz baɪ./
dialogue.zh: 媽媽打電話，姊姊會過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calls are good, does your mother talk long?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔlz ɑr ɡʊd dʌz jɔr ˈmʌðər tɔk lɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 講電話挺好，你媽媽講很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long, but about soup, not about me.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ bʌt əˈbaʊt sup nɑt əˈbaʊt mi./
dialogue.zh: 很久，不過講湯，不講我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soup is a safe topic between people.
dialogue.phonetic: /sup ɪz ə seɪf ˈtɑpɪk bɪˈtwin ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 湯是人與人之間安全的話題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe for her, and easy for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf fɔr hɜr ænd ˈizi fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 對她安全，對我也省力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us leave your mother for a moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs liv jɔr ˈmʌðər fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt./
dialogue.zh: 我們先把你媽媽放一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A moment is fine, she is not the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmoʊmənt ɪz faɪn ʃi ɪz nɑt ðə pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，她不是重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The point is you, and these eleven days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɔɪnt ɪz ju ænd ðiz ɪˈlɛvən deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 重點是你，是這十一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven days, I will start with the first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən deɪz aɪ wɪl stɑrt wɪð ðə fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 十一天，我從第一天說起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday morning, did the alarm ring early?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌndeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ dɪd ðə əˈlɑrm rɪŋ ˈɜrli?/
dialogue.zh: 週一早上，鬧鐘很早響嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six fifteen, same time since my job changed.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˌfɪfˈtin seɪm taɪm sɪns maɪ dʒɑb ʧeɪndʒd./
dialogue.zh: 六點十五，換工作後都這個時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six fifteen leaves you tired by nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˌfɪfˈtin livz ju ˈtaɪərd baɪ naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 六點十五會讓你九點就累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By nine, at my desk, eyes half closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ naɪn æt maɪ dɛsk aɪz hæf kloʊzd./
dialogue.zh: 九點時我在桌前，眼睛半閉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that Monday hard or only slow?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt ˈmʌndeɪ hɑrd ɔr ˈoʊnli sloʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 那個週一是難，還是只是慢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow, the train stopped twice on the bridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ðə treɪn stɑpt twaɪs ɑn ðə brɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 只是慢，火車在橋上停了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice on the bridge, did you stand there?
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɑn ðə brɪdʒ dɪd ju stænd ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 在橋上停兩次，你站著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I stood, holding the cold metal bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stʊd ˈhoʊldɪŋ ðə koʊld ˈmɛtəl bɑr./
dialogue.zh: 我站著，抓著冷冷的金屬桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold metal, long waits, that is the commute.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈmɛtəl lɔŋ weɪts ðæt ɪz ðə kəˈmjut./
dialogue.zh: 冷的金屬、久等，那就是通勤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The commute is my longest stretch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kəˈmjut ɪz maɪ ˈlɔŋɡəst strɛʧ./
dialogue.zh: 通勤是我一天裡最長的一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the office takes most of your day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈɔfɪs teɪks moʊst əv jɔr deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 辦公佔掉你一天大部分的時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then the commute, then the quiet room.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɛn ðə kəˈmjut ðɛn ðə ˈkwaɪət rum./
dialogue.zh: 對，接著通勤，然後是安靜的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet room, is that the one with the lamp?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət rum ɪz ðæt ðə wʌn wɪð ðə læmp?/
dialogue.zh: 安靜的房間，是那有燈的房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My room, the one with the small green lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rum ðə wʌn wɪð ðə smɔl ɡrin læmp./
dialogue.zh: 我的房間，有那盞小綠燈的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The green lamp, did you buy it new?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrin læmp dɪd ju baɪ ɪt nju?/
dialogue.zh: 那盞綠燈是新買的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second hand, from a box at the market.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd hænd frʌm ə bɑks æt ðə ˈmɑrkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 二手的，從市場的一個紙箱上挑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A market find, that is a good sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɑrkɪt faɪnd ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 市場撿到的東西，這是好兆頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign for what, I did not think that far.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪn fɔr wɑt aɪ dɪd nɑt θɪŋk ðæt fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 什麼的兆頭？我沒想那麼遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Far is not needed, we stay in this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɑr ɪz nɑt ˈnidɪd wi steɪ ɪn ðɪs wik./
dialogue.zh: 不用想太遠，我們就留在這一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This week, then, was mostly the same loop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wik ðɛn wʌz ˈmoʊstli ðə seɪm lup./
dialogue.zh: 那這一週基本是同樣的圈子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same loop, which part wore you down?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə seɪm lup wɪʧ pɑrt wɔr ju daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 同樣的圈子，哪一段最耗你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The part with the phone, always the phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑrt wɪð ðə foʊn ˈɔlweɪz ðə foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 拿手機的那一段，總是手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phones are a bright wall between people.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊnz ɑr ə braɪt wɔl bɪˈtwin ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 手機是一堵亮亮的牆，隔開人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is on from six until eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz ɑn frʌm sɪks ʌnˈtɪl ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 我的從六點開到十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven at night, does the light stay on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən æt naɪt dʌz ðə laɪt steɪ ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 晚上十一點，螢幕還亮著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On my face, yes, it makes me sleep late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn maɪ feɪs jɛs ɪt meɪks mi slip leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 照在我臉上，讓我睡得更晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep later, that we can look at soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip ˈleɪtər ðæt wi kæn lʊk æt sun./
dialogue.zh: 睡得晚，我們等一下來看這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon is good, I have been too tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ɪz ɡʊd aɪ hæv bɪn tu ˈtaɪərd./
dialogue.zh: 等一下很好，我一直太累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tired is a word, but how tired, really?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪərd ɪz ə wɜrd bʌt haʊ ˈtaɪərd ˈrɪli?/
dialogue.zh: 累是一個詞，可是你到底多累？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On a scale of one to ten, eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ə skeɪl əv wʌn tu tɛn eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一到十分的話，八分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight is high, where does it sit first?
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ɪz haɪ wɛr dʌz ɪt sɪt fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 八分很高，它先坐在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the shoulders, then behind the eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈʃoʊldərz ðɛn bɪˈhaɪnd ði aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 先在肩膀，然後在眼後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoulders up, are they like that all day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃoʊldərz ʌp ɑr ðeɪ laɪk ðæt ɔl deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 聳著肩，一整天都那樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the desk mostly, and worse at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə dɛsk ˈmoʊstli ænd wɜrs æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 主要在桌前，晚上更糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worse at night, and better by morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrs æt naɪt ænd ˈbɛtər baɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 晚上更糟，早上會好一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, morning starts at the same eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ stɑrts æt ðə seɪm eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不會，早上一開始就是八分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same eight in the morning, that is heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm eɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðæt ɪz ˈhɛvi./
dialogue.zh: 早上就八分，那很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy, yes, and my coffee cup is big.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi jɛs ænd maɪ ˈkɔfi kʌp ɪz bɪɡ./
dialogue.zh: 很重，而且我的咖啡杯很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big cups of coffee, how many per day?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ kʌps əv ˈkɔfi haʊ ˈmɛni pɜr deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 大杯的咖啡，一天喝幾杯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three, one before work, two after lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri wʌn bɪˈfɔr wɜrk tu ˈæftər lʌnʧ./
dialogue.zh: 三杯，上班前一杯，午飯後兩杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two after lunch, do they help the sleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈæftər lʌnʧ du ðeɪ hɛlp ðə slip?/
dialogue.zh: 午飯後兩杯，對睡有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They help the hour, not the night part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ hɛlp ði ˈaʊər nɑt ðə naɪt pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 幫的是下午那小時，不是夜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Afternoons need help, nights need the quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæftərˈnuns nid hɛlp naɪts nid ðə ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 下午需要幫忙，夜裡需要安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet is the part I keep losing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət ɪz ðə pɑrt aɪ kip ˈluzɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 安靜正是我常常弄丟的那一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When did the losing of quiet start?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn dɪd ðə ˈluzɪŋ əv ˈkwaɪət stɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 弄丟安靜是從什麼時候開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around the move, when I changed my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd ðə muv wɛn aɪ ʧeɪndʒd maɪ dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 大概從搬家、換工作那時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The move and the job, both at once?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə muv ænd ðə dʒɑb boʊθ æt wʌns?/
dialogue.zh: 搬家和工作，同時發生？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same month, and I did not plan it.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm mʌnθ ænd aɪ dɪd nɑt plæn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 同一個月，我並沒有計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big changes take more room, do they not?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ ˈʧeɪndʒɪz teɪk mɔr rum du ðeɪ nɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 大的變動佔比較多空間，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room in the flat, and room in my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum ɪn ðə flæt ænd rum ɪn maɪ hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 佔房子的空間，也佔腦子的空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your new flat, is the wall thin there?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr nju flæt ɪz ðə wɔl θɪn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 你的新住處，牆薄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thin, I hear the television at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn aɪ hɪr ðə ˈtɛləˌvɪʒən æt ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 薄，七點我會聽到隔壁的電視。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Television through the wall, how does that feel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛləˌvɪʒən θru ðə wɔl haʊ dʌz ðæt fil?/
dialogue.zh: 電視聲穿牆而過，那感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like living in someone else's evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn ˈsʌmwʌn ˈɛlsˌiz ˈivnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 像活在別人的傍晚裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud evenings, and also the hallway light?
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ˈivnɪŋz ænd ˈɔlsoʊ ðə ˈhɔlweɪ laɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 晚上吵，走廊的燈也亮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hall light is bright all night long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɔl laɪt ɪz braɪt ɔl naɪt lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 走廊燈整夜都很亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the light come under your door?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə laɪt kʌm ˈʌndər jɔr dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 光會從你門下鑽進來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In a thin line, right over my feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə θɪn laɪn raɪt ˈoʊvər maɪ fit./
dialogue.zh: 一條細細的光，正好在我的腳上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tape can cover that line, cheap tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp kæn ˈkʌvər ðæt laɪn ʧip teɪp./
dialogue.zh: 有膠帶可以蓋住那道光，便宜的膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have tape, dark tape, from the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv teɪp dɑrk teɪp frʌm ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 我有，深色的，就在架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark tape, one strip, that is a plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk teɪp wʌn strɪp ðæt ɪz ə plæn./
dialogue.zh: 深色膠帶、一條，這就是計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A plan is more than I had this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə plæn ɪz mɔr ðæn aɪ hæd ðɪs wik./
dialogue.zh: 有計畫，比我這週原本有的多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More than nothing, and nothing is fine too.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ðæn ˈnʌθɪŋ ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz faɪn tu./
dialogue.zh: 比沒有好，而且沒有也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine is a low bar, I will take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ɪz ə loʊ bɑr aɪ wɪl teɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 標準低就低，我願意接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us check your meals in these days.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ʧɛk jɔr milz ɪn ðiz deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我們看看你這幾天的吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Meals are small, rice at one, soup late.
dialogue.phonetic: /milz ɑr smɔl raɪs æt wʌn sup leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 吃得很少，一點吃飯，湯很晚才喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rice at one, did you sit down for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs æt wʌn dɪd ju sɪt daʊn fɔr ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 一點吃飯，你有坐下吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Standing, at the counter, with the mail open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ æt ðə ˈkaʊntər wɪð ðə meɪl ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 站著，在流理台前，邊開信件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mail at the table, that is work again.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪl æt ðə ˈteɪbəl ðæt ɪz wɜrk əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 吃飯時看信件，那又是工作了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Work follows me, even into my lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrk ˈfɑloʊz mi ˈivən ˈɪntu maɪ lʌnʧ./
dialogue.zh: 工作跟著我，連我的午餐也跟著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even lunch, does the office call then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən lʌnʧ dʌz ðə ˈɔfɪs kɔl ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 連午餐也是，辦公室那時會打電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two calls last week, both about one file.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kɔlz læst wik boʊθ əˈbaʊt wʌn faɪl./
dialogue.zh: 上週兩通，都是同一個檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One file, and it held your whole week?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn faɪl ænd ɪt hɛld jɔr hoʊl wik?/
dialogue.zh: 一個檔案，就抓住你整週？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It held three days, and my Sunday too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɛld θri deɪz ænd maɪ ˈsʌndeɪ tu./
dialogue.zh: 它抓住三天，連我的週日也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday evenings are the hard part, true?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌndeɪ ˈivnɪŋz ɑr ðə hɑrd pɑrt tru?/
dialogue.zh: 週日晚上是最難的一段，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, the flat gets quiet all at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru ðə flæt ɡɛts ˈkwaɪət ɔl æt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 對，房子突然整個安靜下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet Sunday, then Monday at six fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət ˈsʌndeɪ ðɛn ˈmʌndeɪ æt sɪks ˌfɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 安靜的週日，然後週一六點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The loop again, and I am in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lup əˈɡɛn ænd aɪ æm ɪn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 又是那個圈子，而我在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the loop, is there a small good part?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə lup ɪz ðɛr ə smɔl ɡʊd pɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 在圈子裡，有沒有小小的好部分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The walk to the corner for warm bread.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔk tu ðə ˈkɔrnər fɔr wɔrm brɛd./
dialogue.zh: 走到街角買熱麵包那段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm bread, that smells like a kinder week.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm brɛd ðæt smɛlz laɪk ə ˈkaɪndər wik./
dialogue.zh: 熱麵包，聞起來像比較溫柔的一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kinder, yes, and it costs only coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaɪndər jɛs ænd ɪt kɔsts ˈoʊnli kɔɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 比較溫柔，而且只花幾個銅板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coins and bread, we will keep those days.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔɪnz ænd brɛd wi wɪl kip ðoʊz deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 銅板和麵包，那些日子我們留住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them, and the nights are still long.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm ænd ðə naɪts ɑr stɪl lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 留住它們，可是夜還是太長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nights, then, are the long part.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪts ðɛn ɑr ðə lɔŋ pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 那麼，晚上的時間最長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The long part, yes, from eleven to three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɔŋ pɑrt jɛs frʌm ɪˈlɛvən tu θri./
dialogue.zh: 最長的那段，從十一點到三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven to three, are you awake all of it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən tu θri ɑr ju əˈweɪk ɔl əv ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 十一點到三點，你都醒著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not all, but enough to hear the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɔl bʌt ɪˈnʌf tu hɪr ðə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 不全醒，但夠我聽到冰箱的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fridge hums, and the street lamp blinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frɪdʒ hʌmz ænd ðə strit læmp blɪŋks./
dialogue.zh: 冰箱低鳴，街燈一閃一閃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One blink each hour, I count on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn blɪŋk iʧ ˈaʊər aɪ kaʊnt ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 每小時閃一次，我靠著它數時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counting lights is work, not rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪŋ laɪts ɪz wɜrk nɑt rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 數燈光是工作，不是休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Work is what my bed has become.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrk ɪz wʌt maɪ bɛd hæz bəˈkʌm./
dialogue.zh: 我的床已經變成工作的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your bed, is the sheet clean and cool?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr bɛd ɪz ðə ʃit klin ænd kul?/
dialogue.zh: 你的床，床單乾淨又涼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool on one side, warm on the other.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ɑn wʌn saɪd wɔrm ɑn ði ˈʌðər./
dialogue.zh: 一邊涼，另一邊已經溫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it then, the cool side helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt ðɛn ðə kul saɪd hɛlps./
dialogue.zh: 那就翻一面，涼的那邊有幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I turn, but my hands stay cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɜrn bʌt maɪ hændz steɪ koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 我翻了，可我的手還是冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold hands, did you wash them in warm water?
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld hændz dɪd ju wɑʃ ðɛm ɪn wɔrm ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 冷冷的手，有用溫水洗過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, at ten, then the phone took me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs æt tɛn ðɛn ðə foʊn tʊk mi./
dialogue.zh: 有，十點洗的，然後手機把我抓走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The phone at ten, what did you see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə foʊn æt tɛn wʌt dɪd ju si?/
dialogue.zh: 十點的手機，你看到什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Work mail, eight new emails about one file.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrk meɪl eɪt nju ˈimeɪlz əˈbaʊt wʌn faɪl./
dialogue.zh: 工作的信，八封新信都在講同一個檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight emails at ten, did you answer them?
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈimeɪlz æt tɛn dɪd ju ˈænsər ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 十點就有八封，你有回嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, and then my mind stayed at work.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ænd ðɛn maɪ maɪnd steɪd æt wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 回了兩封，思緒就留在辦公室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind at work, body in the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnd æt wɜrk ˈbɑdi ɪn ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 人在床上，腦還在公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is my night, two places at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪ naɪt tu ˈplæsɪz æt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 我的夜就是這樣，同時在兩個地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two places, no wonder sleep is late.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈplæsɪz noʊ ˈwʌndər slip ɪz leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 兩個地方，難怪睡來得晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep comes when the sky is already gray.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip kʌmz wɛn ðə skaɪ ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɡreɪ./
dialogue.zh: 睡總在天已經灰白的時候來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grey at five, is that your usual hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ æt faɪv ɪz ðæt jɔr ˈjuʒuəl ˈaʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 五點天灰，那是你平常的時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four forty most nights, five on Fridays.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈfɔrti moʊst naɪts faɪv ɑn ˈfraˌdeɪz./
dialogue.zh: 多半是四點四十，週五會到五點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four forty, and then you rise when?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈfɔrti ænd ðɛn ju raɪz wɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 四點四十睡，那你幾點起床？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six fifteen, the alarm does not care.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˌfɪfˈtin ðə əˈlɑrm dʌz nɑt kɛr./
dialogue.zh: 六點十五，鬧鐘才不管我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only ninety-five minutes of sleep then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈnaɪnti faɪv ˈmɪnɪts əv slip ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就只睡九十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety-five minutes, and I do not move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ænd aɪ du nɑt muv./
dialogue.zh: 九十五分鐘，我也不敢動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you nap after work, to pay it back?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju næp ˈæftər wɜrk tu peɪ ɪt bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 你下班會小睡，把睡眠補回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes on the couch, most nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ɑn ðə kaʊʧ moʊst naɪts./
dialogue.zh: 多數晚上在沙發睡二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The couch nap, does it help or hurt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kaʊʧ næp dʌz ɪt hɛlp ɔr hɜrt?/
dialogue.zh: 沙發上那一覺，是有用還是有害？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It helps the hour, and hurts the eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɛlps ði ˈaʊər ænd hɜrts ði ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 它幫了那小時，卻害了十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven is your start, the lights out hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən ɪz jɔr stɑrt ðə laɪts aʊt ˈaʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 十一點是你的起點，關燈的時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lights out, but my eyes stay open.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪts aʊt bʌt maɪ aɪz steɪ ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 燈關了，我的眼睛還張著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open eyes in the dark need something.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən aɪz ɪn ðə dɑrk nid ˈsʌmθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 黑夜裡睜開的眼睛需要東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They need a page, so I read twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ nid ə peɪdʒ soʊ aɪ rid twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 它們要一頁紙，所以同一頁我讀兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice the page means twice the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ðə peɪdʒ minz twaɪs ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 同一頁讀兩次，光也多照兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lamp by the bed is very small.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp baɪ ðə bɛd ɪz ˈvɛri smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 床邊那盞燈很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small lamps are kind to tired eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl læmps ɑr kaɪnd tu ˈtaɪərd aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 小燈對疲倦的眼睛比較溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind, and my book is one long novel.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd ænd maɪ bʊk ɪz wʌn lɔŋ ˈnɑvəl./
dialogue.zh: 溫柔是溫柔，我讀的是一本長小說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A novel is safer than the phone screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈnɑvəl ɪz ˈseɪfər ðæn ðə foʊn skrin./
dialogue.zh: 小說比手機螢幕安全多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safer for my eyes, worse for time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪfər fɔr maɪ aɪz wɜrs fɔr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 對眼睛安全，對時間更壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time, is the clock facing you now?
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm ɪz ðə klɑk ˈfeɪsɪŋ ju naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 時間啊，時鐘現在是不是對著你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, and I know every number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ænd aɪ noʊ ˈɛvri ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 是的，每一個數字我都認得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the clock to the wall tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə klɑk tu ðə wɔl təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚把時鐘轉向牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the wall, and the numbers go away?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə wɔl ænd ðə ˈnʌmbərz ɡoʊ əˈweɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 只對著牆，數字就不見了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The numbers go, the habit stays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnʌmbərz ɡoʊ ðə ˈhæbɪt steɪz./
dialogue.zh: 數字不見了，習慣還留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I need something else to do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ nid ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛls tu du./
dialogue.zh: 那我需要另一件事可做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something else: one warm cup, no phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛls wʌn wɔrm kʌp noʊ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 另一件事：一杯溫的，不帶手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk, and I will use the tall pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk ænd aɪ wɪl juz ðə tɔl pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 牛奶，我要用那個高一點的鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm milk, and honey if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm mɪlk ænd ˈhʌni ɪf ju laɪk./
dialogue.zh: 溫牛奶，喜歡的話加蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honey is good, the jar is on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌni ɪz ɡʊd ðə dʒɑr ɪz ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜不錯，罐子放在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Top shelf, and I will note it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp ʃɛlf ænd aɪ wɪl noʊt ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 最上面那層，我把它記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Note it, then I only carry the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊt ɪt ðɛn aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈkæri ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 記下來，我只要帶那張卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The card lists the steps in order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrd lɪsts ðə stɛps ɪn ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 卡片上按順序寫著步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In order, that is what I lack at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ˈɔrdər ðæt ɪz wʌt aɪ læk æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有順序，正是我夜裡缺的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lack is not wrong, it means practice.
dialogue.phonetic: /læk ɪz nɑt rɔŋ ɪt minz ˈpræktɪs./
dialogue.zh: 缺的不是錯，是還沒練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Practice at three, that feels strange.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpræktɪs æt θri ðæt filz streɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 三點練習，感覺很怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strange is fine, three is a quiet hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪndʒ ɪz faɪn θri ɪz ə ˈkwaɪət ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 怪也無妨，三點是很靜的鐘點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet, except the fridge and my thoughts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət ɪkˈsɛpt ðə frɪdʒ ænd maɪ θɔts./
dialogue.zh: 很靜，除了冰箱和我腦袋裡的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thoughts at three, are they about work?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɔts æt θri ɑr ðeɪ əˈbaʊt wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 三點的念頭，是關於工作的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, and about my sister's key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ænd əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈsɪstərz ki./
dialogue.zh: 多半是工作，還有姊姊那把鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The key, is that an open question?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ki ɪz ðæt ən ˈoʊpən ˈkwɛsʧən?/
dialogue.zh: 那把鑰匙，是一個還沒定的問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open, she asked me to move back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ʃi æskt mi tu muv bæk./
dialogue.zh: 還沒定，她要我搬回去住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move back, and the flat here is new.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv bæk ænd ðə flæt hɪr ɪz nju./
dialogue.zh: 搬回去，可這裡的住所才剛搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New, and still full of boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju ænd stɪl fʊl əv ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 很新，而且還堆滿紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boxes on the floor, do they bother you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑksɪz ɑn ðə flɔr du ðeɪ ˈbɑðər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 地上的紙箱，會困擾你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At three, yes, they look like people.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt θri jɛs ðeɪ lʊk laɪk ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 三點時會，它們看起來像人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like people, and the lamp makes shadows.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ˈpipəl ænd ðə læmp meɪks ˈʃædoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 像人，而且小燈又造出影子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shadows I know, yet my body jumps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃædoʊz aɪ noʊ jɛt maɪ ˈbɑdi dʒʌmps./
dialogue.zh: 影子我認得，可身體還是會一跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your body is on guard at three.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈbɑdi ɪz ɑn ɡɑrd æt θri./
dialogue.zh: 你的身體三點時還在守夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On guard, though nothing is happening.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ɡɑrd ðoʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz ˈhæpənɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 在守夜，雖然什麼事也沒發生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing happening is the hard lesson.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈhæpənɪŋ ɪz ðə hɑrd ˈlɛsən./
dialogue.zh: 什麼都沒發生，這一課最難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lesson for me, or lesson for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛsən fɔr mi ɔr ˈlɛsən fɔr ju?/
dialogue.zh: 是給我的課，還是給你的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both, the hour teaches us things.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ðə ˈaʊər ˈtiʧɪz ʌs θɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 兩個都是，那個鐘點教我們事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It teaches waiting, and also noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈtiʧɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ ænd ˈɔlsoʊ nɔɪz./
dialogue.zh: 它教我等，也教我聽見吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Waiting in the dark is a skill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈweɪtɪŋ ɪn ðə dɑrk ɪz ə skɪl./
dialogue.zh: 在黑暗裡等是一種能力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A skill I never went to school for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə skɪl aɪ ˈnɛvər wɛnt tu skul fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 這種能力，學校沒教過我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can teach it here, in daylight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn tiʧ ɪt hɪr ɪn ˈdeɪˌlaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在這裡、在白天的光裡教。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Daylight is easy, night is the test.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪˌlaɪt ɪz ˈizi naɪt ɪz ðə tɛst./
dialogue.zh: 白天容易，夜裡才是考試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question about the weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛsʧən əˈbaʊt ðə ˈwikˌɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 再問一個關於假日的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday I sleep until noon, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ aɪ slip ʌnˈtɪl nun ˈmeɪbi./
dialogue.zh: 週六我會睡到中午，也許。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noon, and does that fix the tired part?
dialogue.phonetic: /nun ænd dʌz ðæt fɪks ðə ˈtaɪərd pɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 中午，那能修好疲倦嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I wake at two feeling guilty.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ weɪk æt tu ˈfilɪŋ ˈɡɪlti./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我兩點就醒，還帶著內疚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guilty for resting, that is common.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪlti fɔr ˈrɛstɪŋ ðæt ɪz ˈkɑmən./
dialogue.zh: 為休息而內疚，這很常見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Common, yet it costs me my Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmən jɛt ɪt kɔsts mi maɪ ˈsʌndeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 常見，但它花掉我的週日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The nap rule: twenty, and before four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə næp rul ˈtwɛnti ænd bɪˈfɔr fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 小睡的規則：二十分鐘，四點前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty before four, I will write that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti bɪˈfɔr fɔr aɪ wɪl raɪt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘、四點前，我把它寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write it on the card, in pencil.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ɑn ðə kɑrd ɪn ˈpɛnsəl./
dialogue.zh: 用鉛筆寫在那張卡片上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pencil again, so I can rub it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəl əˈɡɛn soʊ aɪ kæn rʌb ɪt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 又是鉛筆，這樣我才擦得掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rub it out only if the night changes.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌb ɪt aʊt ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə naɪt ˈʧeɪndʒɪz./
dialogue.zh: 只有夜裡的狀況變了才擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nights change slowly, I have seen that.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪts ʧeɪndʒ ˈsloʊli aɪ hæv sin ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 夜改變得很慢，我看過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slowly is the way, not all at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli ɪz ðə weɪ nɑt ɔl æt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢才是路子，不是一次全變。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So my bed stays a place for rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ bɛd steɪz ə pleɪs fɔr rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 所以我的床還能留作休息的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One rule for the bed: no work there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn rul fɔr ðə bɛd noʊ wɜrk ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 床有一條規則：不把工作帶上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No mail, no notes, only the novel.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ meɪl noʊ noʊts ˈoʊnli ðə ˈnɑvəl./
dialogue.zh: 不看信件，不寫筆記，只帶那本小說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The novel ends somewhere near four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnɑvəl ɛndz ˈsʌmwɛr nɪr fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 小說大概在四點前後讀完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Near four, and then maybe real sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɪr fɔr ænd ðɛn ˈmeɪbi ril slip./
dialogue.zh: 四點前後，然後也許真的睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real sleep, small amount, that is progress.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril slip smɔl əˈmaʊnt ðæt ɪz ˈprɑɡrɛs./
dialogue.zh: 真的睡，哪怕一小段，那也是進步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Progress in the night, work in the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɑɡrɛs ɪn ðə naɪt wɜrk ɪn ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 夜裡有一點進步，白天全是工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the work part, tell me about the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə wɜrk pɑrt tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 現在來說工作，跟我講講你的桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday starts with forty new emails.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌndeɪ stɑrts wɪð ˈfɔrti nju ˈimeɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 週一從四十封新信開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty by eight, who writes them all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti baɪ eɪt hu raɪts ðɛm ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 八點前就有四十封，誰寫的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The team, and the boss, and the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tim ænd ðə bɔs ænd ðə klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 團隊、主管，還有時間本身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your boss, is he a loud man?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr bɔs ɪz hi ə laʊd mæn?/
dialogue.zh: 你的主管，他說話很大聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft voice, but the mail is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft vɔɪs bʌt ðə meɪl ɪz laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 他聲音輕，但他的信很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud mail, does it come in meetings?
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd meɪl dʌz ɪt kʌm ɪn ˈmitɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 吵人的信，開會時也會來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every Monday, eleven of us, one screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈmʌndeɪ ɪˈlɛvən əv ʌs wʌn skrin./
dialogue.zh: 每個週一，我們十一個人對著一塊螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven people, and you sit where?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən ˈpipəl ænd ju sɪt wɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 十一個人，你坐在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the end, near the door, quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ði ɛnd nɪr ðə dɔr ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 在最裡面，靠近門，很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet at the end, do you speak there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət æt ði ɛnd du ju spik ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 坐在最深處，你會開口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, if the idea is already mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns ɪf ði aɪˈdiə ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 說一次，如果那個想法本來就是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ideas need air, silence keeps them flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪˈdiz nid ɛr ˈsaɪləns kips ðɛm flæt./
dialogue.zh: 想法需要空氣，沉默會讓它扁掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat is how my voice feels there.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt ɪz haʊ maɪ vɔɪs filz ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 在那裡，我的聲音就是扁扁的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your voice, is it low at home too?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr vɔɪs ɪz ɪt loʊ æt hoʊm tu?/
dialogue.zh: 你的聲音，在家也這麼小嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At home I am louder, yes, mostly.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt hoʊm aɪ æm ˈlaʊdər jɛs ˈmoʊstli./
dialogue.zh: 在家我比較大聲，多數時候是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Louder at home, is that a good sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaʊdər æt hoʊm ɪz ðæt ə ɡʊd saɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 在家比較大聲，這是好現象嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means the flat is safer, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt minz ðə flæt ɪz ˈseɪfər aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 那代表住的地方比較安全，我想。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safer walls, and the boss has one file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪfər wɔlz ænd ðə bɔs hæz wʌn faɪl./
dialogue.zh: 比較安全的牆，然後主管手上有個檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red file, it moved to my desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd faɪl ɪt muvd tu maɪ dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 那個紅色檔案，它搬到我桌上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moved to you, was that asked or given?
dialogue.phonetic: /muvd tu ju wʌz ðæt æskt ɔr ˈɡɪvən?/
dialogue.zh: 搬給你，是有問過還是直接給？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Given, at four, with no word at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪvən æt fɔr wɪð noʊ wɜrd æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 直接給，四點放的，一句話也沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No word, and the deadline is Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wɜrd ænd ðə ˈdɛdˌlaɪn ɪz ˈθɜrzdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有一句話，到期日卻是週四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday night, so I have three days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzdeɪ naɪt soʊ aɪ hæv θri deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 週四晚上，滿打滿算三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days for that file, is that fair?
dialogue.phonetic: /θri deɪz fɔr ðæt faɪl ɪz ðæt fɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 三天做那個檔案，公平嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair for two, not fair for one.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr fɔr tu nɑt fɛr fɔr wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 兩個人做公平，一個人就不公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not fair is a true sentence, hold it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fɛr ɪz ə tru ˈsɛntəns hoʊld ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 覺得不公平是句真話，你先握住它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it where, I say nothing aloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt wɛr aɪ seɪ ˈnʌθɪŋ əˈlaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 握在哪裡呢？我從不出聲說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing aloud, so the thought stays inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ əˈlaʊd soʊ ðə θɔt steɪz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 沒說出口，想法就留在身體裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside, it turns at three, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt tɜrnz æt θri ju noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 在裡面，它三點開始轉動，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the file and the clock at three.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə faɪl ænd ðə klɑk æt θri./
dialogue.zh: 是的，檔案和時鐘都在三點出現。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same two guests, they sit on my bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm tu ɡɛsts ðeɪ sɪt ɑn maɪ bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 同樣那兩位客人，它們坐在我床上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guests, and the printer takes your lunch too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛsts ænd ðə ˈprɪntər teɪks jɔr lʌnʧ tu./
dialogue.zh: 客人啊，印表機也吃掉你的午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The printer jam, I fixed it twice Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɪntər dʒæm aɪ fɪkst ɪt twaɪs ˈmʌndeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 卡紙那次，週一我修了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fixed it twice, and no one came to help?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪkst ɪt twaɪs ænd noʊ wʌn keɪm tu hɛlp?/
dialogue.zh: 修了兩次，沒有人來幫忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tom left in June, so the team is thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑm lɛft ɪn dʒun soʊ ðə tim ɪz θɪn./
dialogue.zh: 湯姆六月離職了，人手變很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin team, and the work stayed the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn tim ænd ðə wɜrk steɪd ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 人手變薄，工作卻完全沒變少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly the same, now in fewer hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðə seɪm naʊ ɪn ˈfjʊər hændz./
dialogue.zh: 一模一樣，只是分給更少的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fewer hands, more pages, that is the math.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfjʊər hændz mɔr ˈpeɪdʒɪz ðæt ɪz ðə mæθ./
dialogue.zh: 更少的手、更多的頁，那就是算法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The math is old, I do the sum daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæθ ɪz oʊld aɪ du ðə sʌm ˈdeɪli./
dialogue.zh: 那個算法很舊，我每天算一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Daily sums at the desk, no lunch break.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪli sʌmz æt ðə dɛsk noʊ lʌnʧ breɪk./
dialogue.zh: 每天在桌前算，沒有午休。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half a sandwich, one eye on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə ˈsændwɪʧ wʌn aɪ ɑn ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 半個三明治，一隻眼睛看著螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One eye, and the other one is dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn aɪ ænd ði ˈʌðər wʌn ɪz draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一隻眼睛看著，另一隻乾乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry from the fan, the office air is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ frʌm ðə fæn ðə ˈɔfɪs ɛr ɪz koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 被出風口吹乾的，辦公室的空氣很冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold air, a scarf, and the meeting room.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ɛr ə skɑrf ænd ðə ˈmitɪŋ rum./
dialogue.zh: 冷冷的空氣、一條圍巾，還有會議室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The glass room, everyone hears everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡlæs rum ˈɛvriˌwʌn hɪrz ˈɛvriˌwʌn./
dialogue.zh: 玻璃那間，每個人都聽得到每個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glass walls make a loud quiet place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæs wɔlz meɪk ə laʊd ˈkwaɪət pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 玻璃牆做出很吵的安靜空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud quiet, that is exactly my office.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ˈkwaɪət ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli maɪ ˈɔfɪs./
dialogue.zh: 吵的安靜，那就是我的辦公室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your office, does it have any plants?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈɔfɪs dʌz ɪt hæv ˈɛni plænts?/
dialogue.zh: 你的辦公室裡有植物嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dead plant, on the filing cabinet.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn dɛd plænt ɑn ðə ˈfaɪlɪŋ ˈkæbɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一棵枯了的，在檔案櫃上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dead plants get new life here, sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛd plænts ɡɛt nju laɪf hɪr ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 枯植物在這裡偶爾會回生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes is kind, the plant is still dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ɪz kaɪnd ðə plænt ɪz stɪl dɛd./
dialogue.zh: 偶爾也不錯，但那棵還是枯的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let the plant be, we have your hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ðə plænt bi wi hæv jɔr ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 植物先放著，我們來看你的鐘點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine hours seated, six standing, none resting.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈaʊərz ˈsitɪd sɪks ˈstændɪŋ nʌn ˈrɛstɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 坐九小時，站六小時，休息是零。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None resting, and the bus home is late.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn ˈrɛstɪŋ ænd ðə bʌs hoʊm ɪz leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 完全休息不到，回家的公車又慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late by twenty, I stand holding the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt baɪ ˈtwɛnti aɪ stænd ˈhoʊldɪŋ ðə reɪl./
dialogue.zh: 慢了二十分鐘，我站著抓扶手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing on the bus is not rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ ɑn ðə bʌs ɪz nɑt rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 在公車上站著不算休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a bridge, from work to home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə brɪdʒ frʌm wɜrk tu hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 它是一條橋，從工作通到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bridge, and the laptop waits at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə brɪdʒ ænd ðə ˈlæpˌtɑp weɪts æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 一條橋，可是筆電在家等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sleeps in my bag, always awake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt slips ɪn maɪ bæɡ ˈɔlweɪz əˈweɪk./
dialogue.zh: 它睡在我的包裡，其實一直醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awake laptops, does the screen glow nightly?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪk ˈlæpˌtɑps dʌz ðə skrin ɡloʊ ˈnaɪtli?/
dialogue.zh: 醒著的筆電，螢幕每晚都發光嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glowing from nine till past midnight often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡloʊɪŋ frʌm naɪn tɪl pæst ˈmɪdˌnaɪt ˈɔfən./
dialogue.zh: 從九點亮到半夜以後，常常如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Past midnight, what do you do then?
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ˈmɪdˌnaɪt wʌt du ju du ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 過了半夜，那你做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, I just sit and look at the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ aɪ dʒʌst sɪt ænd lʊk æt ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 什麼都不做，只坐著看螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sitting with it, is that the worry?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪtɪŋ wɪð ɪt ɪz ðæt ðə ˈwɜri?/
dialogue.zh: 就那樣坐著，那是擔憂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The worry is one line in the file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɜri ɪz wʌn laɪn ɪn ðə faɪl./
dialogue.zh: 擔憂就是檔案裡的其中一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One line, can you show me what it says?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn kæn ju ʃoʊ mi wʌt ɪt sɛz?/
dialogue.zh: 其中一行，你能說給我聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says the numbers do not add up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz ðə ˈnʌmbərz du nɑt æd ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 它寫著那些數字對不起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Numbers not adding, is that your mistake?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbərz nɑt ˈædɪŋ ɪz ðæt jɔr mɪsˈteɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 數字對不起來，是你的錯誤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It may be mine, I check it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt meɪ bi maɪn aɪ ʧɛk ɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 也許是我的，我檢查過兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice is enough, a third is fear talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz ɪˈnʌf ə θɜrd ɪz fɪr ˈtɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 兩次夠了，第三次是害怕在說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fear talking, yes, that is my Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪr ˈtɔkɪŋ jɛs ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈθɜrzdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 害怕在說話，對，那就是我的週四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday, the deadline, and one kind colleague?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzdeɪ ðə ˈdɛdˌlaɪn ænd wʌn kaɪnd ˈkɑliɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 週四、到期日，有善良的同事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ann brings me tea, that is the kind part.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn brɪŋz mi ti ðæt ɪz ðə kaɪnd pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 安會幫我帶茶，那就是善的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ann with tea, is that a small ritual?
dialogue.phonetic: /æn wɪð ti ɪz ðæt ə smɔl ˈrɪʧuəl?/
dialogue.zh: 安和那杯茶，算一個小儀式嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ritual, a big word, it is just tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪʧuəl ə bɪɡ wɜrd ɪt ɪz dʒʌst ti./
dialogue.zh: 儀式是大了點，其實只是茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just tea, and just a held pause.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ti ænd dʒʌst ə hɛld pɔz./
dialogue.zh: 只是茶，也是一次停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pause is hard for me, I keep moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔz ɪz hɑrd fɔr mi aɪ kip ˈmuvɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 停下對我很難，我一直動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moving is a way to hide, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmuvɪŋ ɪz ə weɪ tu haɪd ˈmeɪbi./
dialogue.zh: 一直動，也許是躲開的方法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hide from the file, not from the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪd frʌm ðə faɪl nɑt frʌm ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 躲開那個檔案，不是躲開一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The day is bigger than one red file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə deɪ ɪz ˈbɪɡər ðæn wʌn rɛd faɪl./
dialogue.zh: 一天比一個紅色檔案大得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bigger, but it fits in my two hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪɡər bʌt ɪt fɪts ɪn maɪ tu hændz./
dialogue.zh: 是較大，但它裝得進我兩手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hands, and what do they hold for?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hændz ænd wʌt du ðeɪ hoʊld fɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 兩手，它們撐著的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For my mother's medicine, and the rent.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr maɪ ˈmʌðərz ˈmɛdəsɪn ænd ðə rɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 撐我媽的藥，也撐房租。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rent and her, that is real work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛnt ænd hɜr ðæt ɪz ril wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 房租和她，那才是真正的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real work, the office part just pays it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril wɜrk ðə ˈɔfɪs pɑrt dʒʌst peɪz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 真正的是那些，辦公室那份只是付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pays it, so the job has a purpose.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪz ɪt soʊ ðə dʒɑb hæz ə ˈpɜrpəs./
dialogue.zh: 會付錢，所以這份班是有目的的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Purpose is a large word at four pm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrpəs ɪz ə lɑrdʒ wɜrd æt fɔr ˌpiˈɛm./
dialogue.zh: 目的是大詞，下午四點時更是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Large words are allowed here after four.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑrdʒ wɜrdz ɑr əˈlaʊd hɪr ˈæftər fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 大詞在這裡四點以後是被允許的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Allowed here, not at my desk, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaʊd hɪr nɑt æt maɪ dɛsk ˈsædli./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡可以說，可惜在我的桌前不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say it once at your desk tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt wʌns æt jɔr dɛsk təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 明天在你的桌前說一次那句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say what, exactly, may I ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli meɪ aɪ æsk?/
dialogue.zh: 請問，具體要說什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One sentence: this part is not mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛntəns ðɪs pɑrt ɪz nɑt maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 一句話：這一塊不是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not mine, that is short enough to try.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt maɪn ðæt ɪz ʃɔrt ɪˈnʌf tu traɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不是我的，這句夠短，我可以試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try it once, and come back with news.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ɪt wʌns ænd kʌm bæk wɪð nuz./
dialogue.zh: 試一次，然後帶著消息回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: News may be no, and that is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /nuz meɪ bi noʊ ænd ðæt ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對方可能回絕，那也無妨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A no is news, not a name for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə noʊ ɪz nuz nɑt ə neɪm fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 一句拒絕只是消息，不是你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a name, I will keep that sentence.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ə neɪm aɪ wɪl kip ðæt ˈsɛntəns./
dialogue.zh: 不是名字，這句話我會記著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The work part is heavy, and named now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɜrk pɑrt ɪz ˈhɛvi ænd neɪmd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 工作那塊很重，現在它有名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Named, and my shoulders came down an inch.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪmd ænd maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz keɪm daʊn ən ɪnʧ./
dialogue.zh: 有名字了，我的肩膀也鬆下一吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we try three slow breaths, together.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi traɪ θri sloʊ brɛs təˈɡɛðər./
dialogue.zh: 現在我們一起試三次慢呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Together, yes, and I will follow you.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈɡɛðər jɛs ænd aɪ wɪl ˈfɑloʊ ju./
dialogue.zh: 一起，好，我跟著你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, one hand on your stomach.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst wʌn hænd ɑn jɔr ˈstʌmək./
dialogue.zh: 第一，一隻手放在肚子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, it rises less than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ˈraɪzɪz lɛs ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 放這裡，它起伏比我以為的小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less is fine, breathe in for four.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs ɪz faɪn brið ɪn fɔr fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 小也無妨，吸氣數到四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In for four, one, two, three, four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn fɔr fɔr wʌn tu θri fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 吸到四，一、二、三、四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, now out for six, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ aʊt fɔr sɪks ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在吐氣數到六，慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out for six: one, two, three, four, five, six.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt fɔr sɪks wʌn tu θri fɔr faɪv sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 吐到六：一、二、三、四、五、六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six is longer than in, that is the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn ɪn ðæt ɪz ðə pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 吐比吸長，重點就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The point is the long way out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɔɪnt ɪz ðə lɔŋ weɪ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 重點是那條長長的吐氣路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again, in for four, and let the hand rise.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn ɪn fɔr fɔr ænd lɛt ðə hænd raɪz./
dialogue.zh: 再來，吸到四，讓手自己浮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It rose this time, a little, I felt it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt roʊz ðɪs taɪm ə ˈlɪtəl aɪ fɛlt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這次有起來，一點點，我感覺到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is round one of the three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz raʊnd wʌn əv ðə θri./
dialogue.zh: 這算三回合裡的第一回合。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round one, and my chest feels less tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd wʌn ænd maɪ ʧɛst filz lɛs taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 第一回合，我的胸口比較不緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tight chest, we loosen it in round two.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt ʧɛst wi ˈlusən ɪt ɪn raʊnd tu./
dialogue.zh: 緊緊的胸口，第二回合來放鬆它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round two, what does it need from me?
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd tu wʌt dʌz ɪt nid frʌm mi?/
dialogue.zh: 第二回合，它要我給什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your shoulders, drop them one inch.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈʃoʊldərz drɑp ðɛm wʌn ɪnʧ./
dialogue.zh: 你的肩膀，讓它沉下一吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dropped, they were up near my ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɑpt ðeɪ wɜr ʌp nɪr maɪ ɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 沉下來了，剛剛它們快碰到耳朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ears, and jaw, let the teeth part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪrz ænd dʒɔ lɛt ðə tiθ pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 耳朵，還有下巴，讓牙齒分開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Parted, I did not know I held them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrtɪd aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ aɪ hɛld ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 分開了，我都不知道自己咬著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Held tight all day, that takes air.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛld taɪt ɔl deɪ ðæt teɪks ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 整天咬緊，那會吃掉氣息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Air in the nose now, four counts again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛr ɪn ðə noʊz naʊ fɔr kaʊnts əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 現在用鼻子吸，再數四次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nose in, mouth out, no sound needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊz ɪn maʊθ aʊt noʊ saʊnd ˈnidɪd./
dialogue.zh: 鼻子吸、嘴巴吐，不需要出聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out soft, like breathing on cold glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt sɔft laɪk ˈbriðɪŋ ɑn koʊld ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕吐，像對著冷玻璃呵氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold glass, yes, the same slow shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ɡlæs jɛs ðə seɪm sloʊ ʃeɪp./
dialogue.zh: 冷玻璃，對，就是同樣慢的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shape is easier on the second try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃeɪp ɪz ˈisɪər ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd traɪ./
dialogue.zh: 第二次試，那個形狀就容易多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two rounds done, one is left for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu raʊndz dʌn wʌn ɪz lɛft fɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 兩回合做完了，還有一回合給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One left, and my hands are warm now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn lɛft ænd maɪ hændz ɑr wɔrm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 還有一回合，我的手現在溫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm hands, the body heard you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm hændz ðə ˈbɑdi hɜrd ju./
dialogue.zh: 手溫了，身體聽見你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heard me, that is a new feeling.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜrd mi ðæt ɪz ə nju ˈfilɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 聽見我，那是新的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Third and last, one long breath only.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd ænd læst wʌn lɔŋ brɛθ ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 第三回合也是最後，只一次長呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One only, and then I sit and wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈoʊnli ænd ðɛn aɪ sɪt ænd weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 只一次，然後我坐著等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, and count to four inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ænd kaʊnt tu fɔr ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 等，在身體裡面數到四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four inside, then the breath goes out.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ɪnˈsaɪd ðɛn ðə brɛθ ɡoʊz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 裡面數到四，然後氣就出去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is three, all three are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz θri ɔl θri ɑr dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 三次了，三次都完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and the clock still ticks there.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ænd ðə klɑk stɪl tɪks ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 完成了，時鐘在那裡照樣走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock is not an enemy, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk ɪz nɑt ən ˈɛnəmi raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 時鐘不是敵人，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not an enemy, but it counts my night.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ən ˈɛnəmi bʌt ɪt kaʊnts maɪ naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不是敵人，可它數著我的夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It counts, but it cannot take the hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kaʊnts bʌt ɪt ˈkɑnɑt teɪk ði ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 它數，但它拿不走那一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cannot take it, I will try that tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑnɑt teɪk ɪt aɪ wɪl traɪ ðæt təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 拿不走，今晚我就這樣試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight, three breaths before the light off.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt θri brɛs bɪˈfɔr ðə laɪt ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 今晚，關燈前先做三次呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Before the light off, and the phone away.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ðə laɪt ɔf ænd ðə foʊn əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 關燈前，還有把手機挪開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Away means the hall table, not the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪ minz ðə hɔl ˈteɪbəl nɑt ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 挪開是放到玄關的桌上，不是床邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hall table, that is a new rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɔl ˈteɪbəl ðæt ɪz ə nju rul./
dialogue.zh: 玄關的桌子，那是一條新規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New rules need one week of trying.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju rulz nid wʌn wik əv ˈtraɪɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 新規則需要試一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One week, and if the hour at three returns?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn wik ænd ɪf ði ˈaʊər æt θri rɪˈtɜrnz?/
dialogue.zh: 一週，如果三點那個小時又回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then stay still, do the three slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn steɪ stɪl du ðə θri ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 那就坐穩，慢慢做那三次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still at three, my hands know how.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl æt θri maɪ hændz noʊ haʊ./
dialogue.zh: 三點也坐著，我的手會記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do they know, did you practice today?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ðeɪ noʊ dɪd ju ˈpræktɪs təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 手怎麼會記得，你今天練過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but they moved with you just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bʌt ðeɪ muvd wɪð ju dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，可是剛剛它們跟著你動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just now is practice, this room counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst naʊ ɪz ˈpræktɪs ðɪs rum kaʊnts./
dialogue.zh: 剛剛那下就是練習，這個房間算數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counts as what, one breath or ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnts æz wʌt wʌn brɛθ ɔr tɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 算成什麼，一次呼吸還是十次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: As ten good ones, the body does not count.
dialogue.phonetic: /æz tɛn ɡʊd wʌnz ðə ˈbɑdi dʌz nɑt kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 算十次好的，身體不會數數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does not count, then why did I count?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz nɑt kaʊnt ðɛn waɪ dɪd aɪ kaʊnt?/
dialogue.zh: 它不數，那我剛剛數什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Numbers give the mind a small rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbərz ɡɪv ðə maɪnd ə smɔl reɪl./
dialogue.zh: 數字給腦子一條小扶手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A rail, like the bus one I hold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə reɪl laɪk ðə bʌs wʌn aɪ hoʊld./
dialogue.zh: 像扶手，跟公車上我抓的那根一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like that, hold the count, not the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðæt hoʊld ðə kaʊnt nɑt ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 就是那樣，抓住數字，不是抓住一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the count, and set the day down.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə kaʊnt ænd sɛt ðə deɪ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 抓住數字，把一天放下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down on the table, the day can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl ðə deɪ kæn weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 放在桌上，一天會等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It always waits, it is very patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlweɪz weɪts ɪt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈpeɪʃənt./
dialogue.zh: 它總是等，它很有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe once more, then tell me one word.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið wʌns mɔr ðɛn tɛl mi wʌn wɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 再呼吸一次，然後告訴我一個詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One word: warmer.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn wɜrd ˈwɔrmər./
dialogue.zh: 一個詞：比較暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warmer, the same air, different body.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔrmər ðə seɪm ɛr ˈdɪfərənt ˈbɑdi./
dialogue.zh: 比較暖，空氣一樣，身體不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Different, the shoulders came down again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪfərənt ðə ˈʃoʊldərz keɪm daʊn əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 不一樣，肩膀又沉下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again, one round, in four, out six.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn wʌn raʊnd ɪn fɔr aʊt sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 再一次，一回合，吸四吐六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In, hold, out, and the noise drops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn hoʊld aʊt ænd ðə nɔɪz drɑps./
dialogue.zh: 吸、停、吐，聲音就掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drops, is that the fan in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /drɑps ɪz ðæt ðə fæn ɪn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 掉了，是這裡的風扇嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my own loud, it gets smaller.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ maɪ oʊn laʊd ɪt ɡɛts ˈsmɔlər./
dialogue.zh: 不是，是我自己內心的吵，變小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smaller is enough, we do not need silence.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsmɔlər ɪz ɪˈnʌf wi du nɑt nid ˈsaɪləns./
dialogue.zh: 變小就夠，我們不需要全無聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not silence, just one less tight place.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈsaɪləns dʒʌst wʌn lɛs taɪt pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 不是無聲，只是少一個緊的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The jaw comes next, in the next round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɔ kʌmz nɛkst ɪn ðə nɛkst raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 下巴輪到下一次，在下一個回合。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next round, at my desk, at eleven?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst raʊnd æt maɪ dɛsk æt ɪˈlɛvən?/
dialogue.zh: 下一回合，在我的桌上，十一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven at the desk is the best hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən æt ðə dɛsk ɪz ðə bɛst ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 十一點在桌前是最好的小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best hour, before the mail comes back?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst ˈaʊər bɪˈfɔr ðə meɪl kʌmz bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 最好的小時，在信件回來之前嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before the mail, two minutes only.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ðə meɪl tu ˈmɪnɪts ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 在信件之前，只要兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes, and no one will notice.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts ænd noʊ wʌn wɪl ˈnoʊtɪs./
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，而且沒人會發現。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notice is not the goal, your body is.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪs ɪz nɑt ðə ɡoʊl jɔr ˈbɑdi ɪz./
dialogue.zh: 被發現不是目標，你的身體才是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My body, the same one that wakes at three.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbɑdi ðə seɪm wʌn ðæt weɪks æt θri./
dialogue.zh: 我的身體，就是三點醒來那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The body at three can learn new things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɑdi æt θri kæn lɜrn nju θɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 三點的身體也能學新東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Learn at three, that is slower work.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɜrn æt θri ðæt ɪz ˈsloʊər wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 三點學，那是比較慢的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slower work, but it is still work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊər wɜrk bʌt ɪt ɪz stɪl wɜrk./
