dialogue.zh: 比較慢，但那還是活要做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Work without noise, I can do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrk wɪˈðaʊt nɔɪz aɪ kæn du ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 不吵地做，我做得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, one breath before you stand up.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wʌn brɛθ bɪˈfɔr ju stænd ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 現在，站起來之前再呼吸一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In, out, and my feet stay flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn aʊt ænd maɪ fit steɪ flæt./
dialogue.zh: 吸、吐，我的腳踩平在地上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feet flat is a good place to start.
dialogue.phonetic: /fit flæt ɪz ə ɡʊd pleɪs tu stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 腳踩平是不錯的起點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start here, then repeat it in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt hɪr ðɛn rɪˈpit ɪt ɪn ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 從這裡開始，然後在走廊再做一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the hall, with the form card in hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə hɔl wɪð ðə fɔrm kɑrd ɪn hænd?/
dialogue.zh: 在走廊，手上拿著那張卡片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the card and the pencil too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə kɑrd ænd ðə ˈpɛnsəl tu./
dialogue.zh: 對，卡片和鉛筆都拿著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, we are done with the three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wi ɑr dʌn wɪð ðə θri./
dialogue.zh: 好，三次呼吸都做完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and I feel less full of noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ænd aɪ fil lɛs fʊl əv nɔɪz./
dialogue.zh: 做完了，我覺得比較不吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less full, and the hour is nearly over.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs fʊl ænd ði ˈaʊər ɪz ˈnɪrli ˈoʊvər./
dialogue.zh: 比較不滿，這一小時也快結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly over, and I did not look once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪrli ˈoʊvər ænd aɪ dɪd nɑt lʊk wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 快結束了，而且我一次也沒看鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at what, the clock or the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt wʌt ðə klɑk ɔr ðə kɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 看什麼，看時鐘還是看卡片？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At neither, my hands were busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ˈnaɪðər maɪ hændz wɜr ˈbɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 兩個都沒看，我的手一直在忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Busy hands are calm hands, sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪzi hændz ɑr kɑm hændz ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 忙的手有時也是平靜的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes is honest, I will take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ɪz ˈɑnɪst aɪ wɪl teɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 偶爾就很誠實了，我收下這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the three with you, all week long.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə θri wɪð ju ɔl wik lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 把三次呼吸帶回去，一整週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All week, in the bus, and at three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl wik ɪn ðə bʌs ænd æt θri./
dialogue.zh: 一整週，在公車上，也在三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three breaths, one small card, and next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri brɛs wʌn smɔl kɑrd ænd nɛkst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 三次呼吸、一張小卡片，還有下次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, I want the pencil back.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪ wɑnt ðə ˈpɛnsəl bæk./
dialogue.zh: 下次，我要把鉛筆拿回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pencil is yours now, write one line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɛnsəl ɪz jɔrz naʊ raɪt wʌn laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 鉛筆現在是你的，寫一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line of what, about the week?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn ʌv wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə wik?/
dialogue.zh: 一行的什麼，講這一週嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About one small thing, the week has those.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt wʌn smɔl θɪŋ ðə wik hæz ðoz./
dialogue.zh: 講一件小事，這一週有過的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small things, like the bread on Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl θɪŋz laɪk ðə brɛd ɑn ˈsʌndeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 小事，像週日那個麵包？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That bread, write it, it was a good one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt brɛd raɪt ɪt ɪt wʌz ə ɡʊd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那個麵包，寫下來，它確實好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Writing now, warm bread, corner shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈraɪtɪŋ naʊ wɔrm brɛd ˈkɔrnər ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 正在寫，熱麵包，街角那家店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add the hour, six, was it dark then?
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ði ˈaʊər sɪks wʌz ɪt dɑrk ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 把時間也加上，六點，那時天黑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light, the sun came out for ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt ðə sʌn keɪm aʊt fɔr tɛn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 亮的，太陽出來了十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes of sun, write that too.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts əv sʌn raɪt ðæt tu./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘的太陽，那個也寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sun after bread, one line, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌn ˈæftər brɛd wʌn laɪn dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 麵包之後是太陽，一行，好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the second thing, take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈsɛkənd θɪŋ teɪk jɔr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 現在第二件，你慢慢想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My time is short, but one is here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ taɪm ɪz ʃɔrt bʌt wʌn ɪz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我的時間不多，但有一件在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second thing, what did it cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛkənd θɪŋ wʌt dɪd ɪt kɔst?/
dialogue.zh: 第二件，它花了多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, a message from my sister.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ frʌm maɪ ˈsɪstər./
dialogue.zh: 沒花錢，姊姊傳的一則訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A message, what did it say?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ wʌt dɪd ɪt seɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 一則訊息，它寫了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keys are safe, and that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiz ɑr seɪf ænd ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙是安全的，沒有別的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keys, that line took a weight off.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiz ðæt laɪn tʊk ə weɪt ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙，那一句拿掉了一塊重量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off, and I wrote it back at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf ænd aɪ roʊt ɪt bæk æt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 拿掉了，我當下就回了她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write the second, sister and keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈsɪstər ænd kiz./
dialogue.zh: 把第二件寫下，姊姊和鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Written, the pencil mark is light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtn ðə ˈpɛnsəl mɑrk ɪz laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，鉛筆的痕很淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Light marks are fine, ink comes later.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt mɑrks ɑr faɪn ɪŋk kʌmz ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 淡淡的痕就好，墨跡之後再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ink makes it real, pencil makes it loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪŋk meɪks ɪt ril ˈpɛnsəl meɪks ɪt lus./
dialogue.zh: 鋼筆讓它真實，鉛筆讓它可改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loose is honest, one more small thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /lus ɪz ˈɑnɪst wʌn mɔr smɔl θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 可改比較誠實，再一件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A third, the hardest, I will look back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə θɜrd ðə ˈhɑrdəst aɪ wɪl lʊk bæk./
dialogue.zh: 第三件最難，我回頭看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the day, not at the week.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə deɪ nɑt æt ðə wik./
dialogue.zh: 看今天就好，不要看整週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today, the window light at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ laɪt æt fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 今天，四點窗邊的陽光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Window light, was it on the floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊ laɪt wʌz ɪt ɑn ðə flɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 窗邊的光，落在地板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the box pile, it made a square.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə bɑks paɪl ɪt meɪd ə skwɛr./
dialogue.zh: 落在那疊紙箱，變成一個方塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A square of light on the boxes, write it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə skwɛr əv laɪt ɑn ðə ˈbɑksɪz raɪt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 紙箱上的一個光方塊，寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light square, the boxes stay closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt skwɛr ðə ˈbɑksɪz steɪ kloʊzd./
dialogue.zh: 光的方塊，紙箱還關著沒拆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three lines now, read them to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri laɪnz naʊ rid ðɛm tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 現在三行了，唸給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bread, sister, light on boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɛd ˈsɪstər laɪt ɑn ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 麵包、姊姊、紙箱上的光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three small things, no work inside them.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri smɔl θɪŋz noʊ wɜrk ɪnˈsaɪd ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 三件小事，裡面沒有工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No work, that was not on purpose.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wɜrk ðæt wʌz nɑt ɑn ˈpɜrpəs./
dialogue.zh: 沒有工作，那不是故意避開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not on purpose is still an answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɑn ˈpɜrpəs ɪz stɪl ən ˈænsər./
dialogue.zh: 不是故意也算是一種回答。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An answer, so should I add work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈænsər soʊ ʃʊd aɪ æd wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 一種回答，那我要把工作補進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it outside work, that is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd wɜrk ðæt ɪz ðə rul./
dialogue.zh: 把它留在工作外面，這是規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Outside work, my three are outside already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd wɜrk maɪ θri ɑr ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 工作之外，我那三件本來就在外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already three, that is the whole task.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi θri ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl tæsk./
dialogue.zh: 已經三件了，那是全部的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole task, and I did it in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl tæsk ænd aɪ dɪd ɪt ɪn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 全部的事，我在這個房間就做完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In here counts too, but try it at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn hɪr kaʊnts tu bʌt traɪ ɪt æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡也算，不過在家也試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At home, when, right after dinner?
dialogue.phonetic: /æt hoʊm wɛn raɪt ˈæftər ˈdɪnər?/
dialogue.zh: 在家，什麼時候？吃完晚飯之後嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After dinner is good, before the phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ˈdɪnər ɪz ɡʊd bɪˈfɔr ðə foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 晚飯之後好，在拿手機之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Before the phone, that is the hard order.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ðə foʊn ðæt ɪz ðə hɑrd ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 在手機之前，那個順序最難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hard order, do it with the dishes.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑrd ˈɔrdər du ɪt wɪð ðə ˈdɪʃɪz./
dialogue.zh: 順序難，那就收碗的時候做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dishes, then one line on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɪʃɪz ðɛn wʌn laɪn ɑn ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 收完碗，然後在卡片上寫一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The card lives by the kettle, agreed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrd lɪvz baɪ ðə ˈkɛtl əˈɡrid?/
dialogue.zh: 卡片就放在熱水壺旁，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, kettle, card, and one pencil.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid ˈkɛtl kɑrd ænd wʌn ˈpɛnsəl./
dialogue.zh: 好，壺、卡片，再加一支鉛筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pencil, so the list stays soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈpɛnsəl soʊ ðə lɪst steɪz sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 一支鉛筆，清單就可以柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft list, and if a day has none?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft lɪst ænd ɪf ə deɪ hæz nʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 柔軟的清單，若有一天半個也沒有？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None is also a line, write none.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn ɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ə laɪn raɪt nʌn./
dialogue.zh: 沒有也是一行，就寫沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write none, and does that count as done?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt nʌn ænd dʌz ðæt kaʊnt æz dʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 寫沒有，那也算完成嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It counts, the card is not a test.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kaʊnts ðə kɑrd ɪz nɑt ə tɛst./
dialogue.zh: 算完成，卡片不是考試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a test, I felt my chest loosen.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ə tɛst aɪ fɛlt maɪ ʧɛst ˈlusən./
dialogue.zh: 不是考試，我感覺到胸口鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loosen is the aim, one line a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlusən ɪz ði ɪm wʌn laɪn ə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 鬆開就是目的，一天一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line a day, and the card will fill.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn ə deɪ ænd ðə kɑrd wɪl fɪl./
dialogue.zh: 一天一行，卡片總會寫滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When it fills, bring it here again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ɪt fɪlz brɪŋ ɪt hɪr əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 寫滿的時候，再帶它過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it, and we read those three lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt ænd wi rid ðoz θri laɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 我會帶來，我們一起讀那三行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read them aloud, the sound matters too.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðɛm əˈlaʊd ðə saʊnd ˈmætərz tu./
dialogue.zh: 讀出聲，聲音也重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aloud, at the kettle, alone with tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaʊd æt ðə ˈkɛtl əˈloʊn wɪθ ti./
dialogue.zh: 出聲，在壺邊，一個人配茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alone with tea, that is a good scene.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈloʊn wɪθ ti ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd sin./
dialogue.zh: 一個人配茶，那是很好的畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good scene, the first in a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡʊd sin ðə fɜrst ɪn ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 很好的畫面，好久以來的第一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In a while, and that is worth noting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə waɪl ænd ðæt ɪz wɜrθ ˈnoʊtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好久第一次，這一點值得記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth noting, the third line was light.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrθ ˈnoʊtɪŋ ðə θɜrd laɪn wʌz laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 值得記，第三行寫的是光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Light again, the sun stays in your list.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt əˈɡɛn ðə sʌn steɪz ɪn jɔr lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 又是光，太陽留在你的清單裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In my list, sun, bread, sister, keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ lɪst sʌn brɛd ˈsɪstər kiz./
dialogue.zh: 在我的清單裡：太陽、麵包、姊姊、鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four small things in three lines, clever.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr smɔl θɪŋz ɪn θri laɪnz ˈklɛvər./
dialogue.zh: 三行裡有四件小事，真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever, I have one skill left, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɛvər aɪ hæv wʌn skɪl lɛft ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 聰明吧，那我還有本事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the pencil, the card is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə ˈpɛnsəl ðə kɑrd ɪz jɔrz./
dialogue.zh: 鉛筆給你，卡片也是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine, and tomorrow is Wednesday already.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ænd təˈmɑroʊ ɪz ˈwɛnsˌdeɪ ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我的了，明天已經是週三。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wednesday, one line before sleep, try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛnsˌdeɪ wʌn laɪn bɪˈfɔr slip traɪ./
dialogue.zh: 週三，睡前來一行，試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Before sleep, and if I am asleep already?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr slip ænd ɪf aɪ æm əˈslɪp ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 睡前來，如果我早就睡著了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Asleep without a line is also fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈslɪp wɪˈðaʊt ə laɪn ɪz ˈɔlsoʊ faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 沒寫就睡著也還可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also fine, I worried about rules today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ faɪn aɪ ˈwɜrid əˈbaʊt rulz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 還可以，我今天一直在管規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worried is a start, rules come after.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɜrid ɪz ə stɑrt rulz kʌm ˈæftər./
dialogue.zh: 擔心是開頭，規則在後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After, yes, the pencil is in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər jɛs ðə ˈpɛnsəl ɪz ɪn maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 在後面，對，鉛筆在我的包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the bag, so the bus can have one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə bæɡ soʊ ðə bʌs kæn hæv wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 在包裡，公車上也能寫一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the bus, one line about the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə bʌs wʌn laɪn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 在公車上，一行就寫車窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window on the bus, that is honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɑn ðə bʌs ðæt ɪz ˈɑnɪst./
dialogue.zh: 公車上的車窗，那很誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honest, rain again, and my face too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnɪst reɪn əˈɡɛn ænd maɪ feɪs tu./
dialogue.zh: 誠實，又下雨，還有我的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your face in the glass, write that down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr feɪs ɪn ðə ɡlæs raɪt ðæt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 玻璃上你的臉，那個也寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down, and it looks less tired outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ænd ɪt lʊks lɛs ˈtaɪərd ˌaʊtˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 寫下了，窗外的我看起來比較不累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less tired is a true line, keep it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs ˈtaɪərd ɪz ə tru laɪn kip ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 比較不累，那是真話，留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kept, three lines, the card is not full.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɛpt θri laɪnz ðə kɑrd ɪz nɑt fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 留住了，三行，卡片還沒寫滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not full, it holds small things, not big ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fʊl ɪt hoʊldz smɔl θɪŋz nɑt bɪɡ wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 還沒滿，它裝的是小事，不是大事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small ones, the big ones come with sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wʌnz ðə bɪɡ wʌnz kʌm wɪð slip./
dialogue.zh: 小事優先，大事跟著睡眠來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With sleep, yes, we are near the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð slip jɛs wi ɑr nɪr ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 跟著睡眠，對，我們快結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Near the end, and my bag feels lighter.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɪr ði ɛnd ænd maɪ bæɡ filz ˈlaɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 快結束了，我的包感覺比較輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lighter bag, same bag, the mind moved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaɪtər bæɡ seɪm bæɡ ðə maɪnd muvd./
dialogue.zh: 包變輕，包沒換，是腦子動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Moved one inch, that is my whole week.
dialogue.phonetic: /muvd wʌn ɪnʧ ðæt ɪz maɪ hoʊl wik./
dialogue.zh: 動了一吋，那是我的一整週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An inch is a real distance, trust it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ɪnʧ ɪz ə ril ˈdɪstəns trʌst ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一吋也是真的距離，相信它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust it, I will trust one pencil line.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst ɪt aɪ wɪl trʌst wʌn ˈpɛnsəl laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我信，我願意信一行鉛筆字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One line tonight, and one tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn təˈnaɪt ænd wʌn təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 今晚一行，明天也一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow is Wednesday, then Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ɪz ˈwɛnzdeɪ ðɛn ˈθɜrzdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 明天是週三，再來才是週四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On deadline day, one small line helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ˈdɛdˌlaɪn deɪ wʌn smɔl laɪn hɛlps./
dialogue.zh: 交檔那天，一行小事也有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Helps, like a rail for the mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛlps laɪk ə reɪl fɔr ðə maɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 有用，像給腦子一根扶手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mind on the rail, the file waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə maɪnd ɑn ðə reɪl ðə faɪl weɪts./
dialogue.zh: 腦子扶著欄杆，檔案在外面等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits, and I go home in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts ænd aɪ ɡoʊ hoʊm ɪn ðə dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 它等，我在天黑時回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the dark, but the card is in hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə dɑrk bʌt ðə kɑrd ɪz ɪn hænd./
dialogue.zh: 天黑裡，卡片握在手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In hand, three small things, and one breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn hænd θri smɔl θɪŋz ænd wʌn brɛθ./
dialogue.zh: 握在手裡，三件小事，一口呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us fix the next hour now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs fɪks ðə nɛkst ˈaʊər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們現在把下一次的時間定好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fix it, I have my phone in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪks ɪt aɪ hæv maɪ foʊn ɪn ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 好，定下來，我的手機擱在走廊那頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No phone needed, Tuesday at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ foʊn ˈnidɪd ˈtuzdeɪ æt fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 不需要手機，下週二、四點整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday at four, same as today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ æt fɔr seɪm æz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 週二四點，跟今天同一個時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four is your time, the same chair too.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ɪz jɔr taɪm ðə seɪm ʧɛr tu./
dialogue.zh: 四點是你的時段，椅子也一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wide chair, and the small green lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə waɪd ʧɛr ænd ðə smɔl ɡrin læmp./
dialogue.zh: 寬寬的椅子，還有那盞小綠燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same room, number two, near the plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm rum ˈnʌmbər tu nɪr ðə plænts./
dialogue.zh: 同樣的房間，二號，靠近植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number two, the one with the quiet clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbər tu ðə wʌn wɪð ðə ˈkwaɪət klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 二號，就是有時鐘輕聲的那間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is the same clock, it is old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə seɪm klɑk ɪt ɪz oʊld./
dialogue.zh: 是同一個時鐘，它很舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old clocks are steady, I like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld klɑks ɑr ˈstɛdi aɪ laɪk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 舊鐘走得穩，我喜歡這點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next Tuesday, then, four o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈtuzdeɪ ðɛn fɔr oʊ ˈklɑk./
dialogue.zh: 那麼下週二，四點整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, and my bus stops near here.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ænd maɪ bʌs stɑps nɪr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 四點，我搭的公車就在這附近停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your bus, and you walk past the fruit place?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr bʌs ænd ju wɔk pæst ðə frut pleɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 那班公車，你會經過水果店嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, then two blocks to my flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðɛn tu blɑks tu maɪ flæt./
dialogue.zh: 是的，再過兩個街口就是我家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fruit place, is that the one with awnings?
dialogue.phonetic: /frut pleɪs ɪz ðæt ðə wʌn wɪð ˈɔnɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 水果店，是有遮篷那家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red one, they hang over the path.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd wʌn ðeɪ hæŋ ˈoʊvər ðə pæθ./
dialogue.zh: 紅色遮篷那家，篷子垂在人行道上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the awnings, the rain is a guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ði ˈɔnɪŋz ðə reɪn ɪz ə ɡɛst./
dialogue.zh: 篷子下面，雨變成一位客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A guest, and I will bring my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɛst ænd aɪ wɪl brɪŋ maɪ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 是客人，我會把我的卡片帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the card, and the pencil too.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə kɑrd ænd ðə ˈpɛnsəl tu./
dialogue.zh: 帶卡片，鉛筆也一起帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card and pencil, three lines by then.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ænd ˈpɛnsəl θri laɪnz baɪ ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 卡片和鉛筆，到時會有三行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By Tuesday, three lines, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈtuzdeɪ θri laɪnz ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 週二之前三行就好，只要這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More than three, is that allowed too?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ðæn θri ɪz ðæt əˈlaʊd tu?/
dialogue.zh: 多於三行，這樣也可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six lines are fine, the card is wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks laɪnz ɑr faɪn ðə kɑrd ɪz waɪd./
dialogue.zh: 六行也沒關係，卡片很寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wide card, small pencil, my pace.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪd kɑrd smɔl ˈpɛnsəl maɪ peɪs./
dialogue.zh: 寬卡片、小鉛筆，我的步速。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your pace, and one question for next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr peɪs ænd wʌn ˈkwɛsʧən fɔr nɛkst wik./
dialogue.zh: 你的步速，下週再帶一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A question, yes, I have half of one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwɛsʧən jɛs aɪ hæv hæf əv wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 問題啊，我半個已經成形了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half is enough, the rest comes free.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɪz ɪˈnʌf ðə rɛst kʌmz fri./
dialogue.zh: 一半就夠，剩下的會自己來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free, like the water and the warm cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri laɪk ðə ˈwɔtər ænd ðə wɔrm kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 免費的，像水和那杯溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kettle runs all afternoon here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɛtl rʌnz ɔl ˌæftərˈnun hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的熱水壺整個下午都熱著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All afternoon, so I will bring my cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ˌæftərˈnun soʊ aɪ wɪl brɪŋ maɪ kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 整個下午，那我自備杯子來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No cup needed, the shelf has mugs.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kʌp ˈnidɪd ðə ʃɛlf hæz mʌɡz./
dialogue.zh: 不用帶杯子，架子上有馬克杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mugs, one with a blue bird on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌɡz wʌn wɪð ə blu bɜrd ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有杯子，其中一個畫著藍色小鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue bird mug, that is your size.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu bɜrd mʌɡ ðæt ɪz jɔr saɪz./
dialogue.zh: 那隻藍鳥杯，剛好是你的容量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My size, how did you know that one?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ saɪz haʊ dɪd ju noʊ ðæt wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 剛好的容量，你怎麼認得那一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You held it twice in the waiting hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hɛld ɪt twaɪs ɪn ðə ˈweɪtɪŋ hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 你在等候室拿它兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, it has a small handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd ɪt hæz ə smɔl ˈhændəl./
dialogue.zh: 有啊，它的把手小小一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small handles are easy for cold hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈhændəlz ɑr ˈizi fɔr koʊld hændz./
dialogue.zh: 小把手對冷冷的手最友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold hands, yes, and they are warmer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld hændz jɛs ænd ðeɪ ɑr ˈwɔrmər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 冷冷的手，是，不過現在暖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warmer, and the next hour is decided.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔrmər ænd ðə nɛkst ˈaʊər ɪz dɪˈsaɪdɪd./
dialogue.zh: 暖了，下一次的時間也定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Decided, Tuesday, four, room two.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈsaɪdɪd ˈtuzdeɪ fɔr rum tu./
dialogue.zh: 定了，週二，四點，二號室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room two, and the desk will write it.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum tu ænd ðə dɛsk wɪl raɪt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 二號室，櫃台會把它寫進日曆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it down, and I get a message?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt daʊn ænd aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 寫下來之後，我會收到一則提醒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A message two days before, at noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ tu deɪz bɪˈfɔr æt nun./
dialogue.zh: 兩天前會傳一則，中午時分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At noon, when I am at my desk again.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt nun wɛn aɪ æm æt maɪ dɛsk əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 中午，那時我又回到我的桌前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again at noon, that is your hard hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn æt nun ðæt ɪz jɔr hɑrd ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 又是一個難的小時，中午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hard, but the note will wait for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑrd bʌt ðə noʊt wɪl weɪt fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 難，但那則訊息會等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It waits, the same way the file waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts ðə seɪm weɪ ðə faɪl weɪts./
dialogue.zh: 它等，像那個紅色檔案一樣等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like the file, but with no numbers inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðə faɪl bʌt wɪð noʊ ˈnʌmbərz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 像檔案，但裡面沒有數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No numbers, only the chair and the hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈnʌmbərz ˈoʊnli ðə ʧɛr ænd ði ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 沒有數字，只有椅子和那一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chair and the hour, that I can keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʧɛr ænd ði ˈaʊər ðæt aɪ kæn kip./
dialogue.zh: 椅子和一小時，這個我守得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it, and if you cannot come, call.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ænd ɪf ju ˈkɑnɑt kʌm kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 守住它，要是來不了，就打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the desk, and we take another day?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ðə dɛsk ænd wi teɪk əˈnʌðər deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 打給櫃台，然後改另一天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Another day, the desk holds one spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈnʌðər deɪ ðə dɛsk hoʊldz wʌn spɛr./
dialogue.zh: 另一天，櫃台留了一個備用時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One spare, Friday late, is that right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn spɛr ˈfraɪdeɪ leɪt ɪz ðæt raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 一個備用，週五很晚的那個，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday late is not kind to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪdeɪ leɪt ɪz nɑt kaɪnd tu ju./
dialogue.zh: 週五太晚對你不友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not kind, the week is already empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt kaɪnd ðə wik ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈɛmpi./
dialogue.zh: 是不友善，那週我已經空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty by Friday, so Tuesday stands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpi baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ soʊ ˈtuzdeɪ stændz./
dialogue.zh: 到週五就空了，所以週二站得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday stands, and I will be early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ stændz ænd aɪ wɪl bi ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 週二定著，我會早一點到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Early means ten minutes, in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɜrli minz tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɪn ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 早到就是十分鐘，在走廊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes in the hall, with the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɪn ðə hɔl wɪð ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘在走廊，手上拿著卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the hall, one breath, in and out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə hɔl wʌn brɛθ ɪn ænd aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 在走廊裡，呼吸一次，一吸一吐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One round in the hallway, I can do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn raʊnd ɪn ðə ˈhɔlweɪ aɪ kæn du ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 走廊裡一個回合，我做得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the plan: breath, card, chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə plæn brɛθ kɑrd ʧɛr./
dialogue.zh: 這就是計畫：呼吸、卡片、椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plan written, here, on the last line.
dialogue.phonetic: /plæn ˈrɪtn hɪr ɑn ðə læst laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 計畫寫在這裡，最後那行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the last line, and the week's tasks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə læst laɪn ænd ðə wiks tæskz./
dialogue.zh: 最後一行，寫下這一週的小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tasks: three breaths, one line, tape, sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæskz θri brɛs wʌn laɪn teɪp slip./
dialogue.zh: 任務：三次呼吸、一行字、膠帶、睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four tasks, and sleep is the big one.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr tæskz ænd slip ɪz ðə bɪɡ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 四件任務，睡眠是最大的一件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep, I will not chase it tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip aɪ wɪl nɑt ʧeɪs ɪt təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 睡眠，今晚我不去追它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not chase, that is the wisest line today.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ʧeɪs ðæt ɪz ðə ˈwaɪzɪst laɪn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不去追，這是今天最聰明的一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wisest, I write it, and the pencil slips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwaɪzɪst aɪ raɪt ɪt ænd ðə ˈpɛnsəl slɪps./
dialogue.zh: 最聰明，我寫它，鉛筆滑了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slips, and that is honest too.
dialogue.phonetic: /slɪps ænd ðæt ɪz ˈɑnɪst tu./
dialogue.zh: 滑了一下，那也是誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honest, and how long do we meet here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnɪst ænd haʊ lɔŋ du wi mit hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 誠實，那我們在這裡見多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Week by week, no long plan yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /wik baɪ wik noʊ lɔŋ plæn jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 一週一週看，先不排長計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Week by week, that sounds calmer to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wik baɪ wik ðæt saʊndz ˈkɑmər tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 一週一週，聽起來比較安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calmer than a year, yes, one season.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmər ðæn ə jɪr jɛs wʌn ˈsizən./
dialogue.zh: 比一年安靜，先做一季。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A season, and the season has a name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈsizən ænd ðə ˈsizən hæz ə neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 一季，這一季可以有名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You may name it, Tuesday is a start.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪ neɪm ɪt ˈtuzdeɪ ɪz ə stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 名字由你取，週二是開頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call it the slow season, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl ɪt ðə sloʊ ˈsizən ˈmeɪbi./
dialogue.zh: 我也許叫它慢的那一季。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The slow season, I will note that down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sloʊ ˈsizən aɪ wɪl noʊt ðæt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 慢的那一季，我把它記在筆記上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Note it, in pencil, so I can change it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊt ɪt ɪn ˈpɛnsəl soʊ aɪ kæn ʧeɪndʒ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 記下來，用鉛筆，這樣還能改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Change is allowed, the card is soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʧeɪndʒ ɪz əˈlaʊd ðə kɑrd ɪz sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 可以改，這張卡片是柔軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft card, hard Monday, gentle plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft kɑrd hɑrd ˈmʌndeɪ ˈdʒɛntəl plæn./
dialogue.zh: 軟卡片、硬的週一、溫柔的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gentle plan, and Ann with her tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntəl plæn ænd æn wɪð hɜr ti./
dialogue.zh: 溫柔的計畫，還有安和她的茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ann will not know, it is my line.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn wɪl nɑt noʊ ɪt ɪz maɪ laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 安不會知道，這一行是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your line, your card, your slow week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr laɪn jɔr kɑrd jɔr sloʊ wik./
dialogue.zh: 你的一行、你的卡片、你慢的一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My week, and if the three o'clock returns?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ wik ænd ɪf ðə θri oʊ ˈklɑk rɪˈtɜrnz?/
dialogue.zh: 我的一週，如果三點又回來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then do the three, and do not fight it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn du ðə θri ænd du nɑt faɪt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就做三次呼吸，不跟它打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not fight, that will be the hard one.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt faɪt ðæt wɪl bi ðə hɑrd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 不打，那會最難的一項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hard one, and still one small line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɑrd wʌn ænd stɪl wʌn smɔl laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 最難的那項，也還是寫一行小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line even on the bad Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn ˈivən ɑn ðə bæd ˈtuzdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 哪怕那個很壞的週二，也一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even a short line, like today's three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ə ʃɔrt laɪn laɪk təˈdeɪz θri./
dialogue.zh: 短一行也行，像今天的三行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today's three, I carry them on the bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪz θri aɪ ˈkæri ðɛm ɑn ðə bʌs./
dialogue.zh: 今天的三行，我帶上公車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the bus, in the rain, with a card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə bʌs ɪn ðə reɪn wɪð ə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 在公車上、在雨裡、持卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card in the pocket, pencil in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ɪn ðə ˈpɑkɪt ˈpɛnsəl ɪn ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 卡片放口袋，鉛筆放包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one small thing before you go out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn smɔl θɪŋ bɪˈfɔr ju ɡoʊ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 出門之前，還有一件小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One thing, the three breaths, yes, I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ ðə θri brɛs jɛs aɪ si./
dialogue.zh: 那件事，三次呼吸，好，我記得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See is enough, we will see on Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ɪz ɪˈnʌf wi wɪl si ɑn ˈtuzdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 記得就夠，我們週二再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On Tuesday, at four, in room two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ˈtuzdeɪ æt fɔr ɪn rum tu./
dialogue.zh: 週二，四點，二號室見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room two, and the kettle will be warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum tu ænd ðə ˈkɛtl wɪl bi wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 二號室，熱水壺會是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm, and outside the sky looks open.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ænd ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə skaɪ lʊks ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 溫的，而且外面的天空看起來開闊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before you go, the day looks clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ju ɡoʊ ðə deɪ lʊks klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你要出門了，外頭的天很清朗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear, the sun is on the steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪr ðə sʌn ɪz ɑn ðə stɛps./
dialogue.zh: 很清朗，陽光落在台階上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you wear shoes for a long walk?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju wɛr ʃuz fɔr ə lɔŋ wɔk?/
dialogue.zh: 你這雙鞋適合走長路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These are dry now, the rain was early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ɑr draɪ naʊ ðə reɪn wʌz ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 已經乾了，雨是清早下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the long way, the one with trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə lɔŋ weɪ ðə wʌn wɪð triz./
dialogue.zh: 走那條遠一點的路，有樹的那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trees, there is a row past the fruit place.
dialogue.phonetic: /triz ðɛr ɪz ə roʊ pæst ðə frut pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 有樹，水果店過去那一排都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A row of trees gives a slower pace.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə roʊ əv triz ɡɪvz ə ˈsloʊər peɪs./
dialogue.zh: 一排樹會讓人走得更慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pace, I am fast, I have always been.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪs aɪ æm fæst aɪ hæv ˈɔlweɪz bɪn./
dialogue.zh: 說速度嘛，我一直都很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today, half of that speed, no more.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ hæf əv ðæt spid noʊ mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 今天走那個速度的一半就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half speed, and stop at the red awnings?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf spid ænd stɑp æt ðə rɛd ˈɔnɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 半速，然後在紅色遮陽棚那裡停一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop there, count to ten, then move.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ðɛr kaʊnt tu tɛn ðɛn muv./
dialogue.zh: 在那裡數到十，再往前走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten counts, like the breaths, only slower.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn kaʊnts laɪk ðə bɛrθs ˈoʊnli ˈsloʊər./
dialogue.zh: 數十下，像呼吸那樣，只是更慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only slower, yes, the sky helps there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈsloʊər jɛs ðə skaɪ hɛlps ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 只是更慢，對，天光在那裡會幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sky is low today, a soft white.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skaɪ ɪz loʊ təˈdeɪ ə sɔft waɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今天的天壓得低，柔柔的白色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft white, and is there wind on the street?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft waɪt ænd ɪz ðɛr wɪnd ɑn ðə strit?/
dialogue.zh: 柔白，街上風大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, it moves my coat sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ɪt muvz maɪ koʊt sliv./
dialogue.zh: 有一點，它吹動我外套的袖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A coat sleeve, that is real weather talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə koʊt sliv ðæt ɪz riəl ˈwɛðər tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 會說到袖子，那才是真的在講天氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real, and warm, I did not expect that.
dialogue.phonetic: /riəl ænd wɔrm aɪ dɪd nɑt ɪkˈspɛkt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 是真的，而且暖和，我沒料到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Expect nothing, just walk, let it be.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈspɛkt ˈnʌθɪŋ dʒʌst wɔk lɛt ɪt bi./
dialogue.zh: 什麼都別期待，就走，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk on, there is a bench by the tree.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk ɑn ðɛr ɪz ə bɛnʧ baɪ ðə tri./
dialogue.zh: 繼續走，那棵樹旁有一張長椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bench, and is it free at five?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɛnʧ ænd ɪz ɪt fri æt faɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 有長椅嗎？五點的時候它是空的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free at five, that hour is mine now.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri æt faɪv ðæt ˈaʊər ɪz maɪn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 五點是空的，那個鐘點現在是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hour, sit, and leave the phone down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈaʊər sɪt ænd liv ðə foʊn daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你的時段，坐下來，手機放著別碰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No phone, four minutes, and one bird.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ foʊn fɔr ˈmɪnɪts ænd wʌn bɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 不拿手機，四分鐘，還有一隻鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bird, which one sings at that hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɜrd wɪʧ wʌn sɪŋz æt ðæt ˈaʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 一隻鳥，那個鐘點是哪隻在叫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small gray one, maybe the same each day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl ɡreɪ wʌn ˈmeɪbi ðə seɪm iʧ deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 小小灰色那隻，也許每天都是同一隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same bird, that is a small routine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə seɪm bɜrd ðæt ɪz ə smɔl ruˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 同一隻鳥，那也是一個小規律。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Routine, I did not have one last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruˈtin aɪ dɪd nɑt hæv wʌn læst mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 規律啊，上個月我一項都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not last month, but this week has two.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt læst mʌnθ bʌt ðɪs wik hæz tu./
dialogue.zh: 上個月沒有，但這週有兩項了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, the card and the breaths, and now this.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ðə kɑrd ænd ðə bɛrθs ænd naʊ ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 兩項，卡片和呼吸，現在再加上這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit as long as the wood allows.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt æz lɔŋ æz ðə wʊd əˈlaʊz./
dialogue.zh: 木椅讓你坐多久，你就坐多久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds me, the wood is dry today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hoʊldz mi ðə wʊd ɪz draɪ təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 它撐得住我，木頭今天是乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry wood, open sky, one slow body.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ wʊd ˈoʊpən skaɪ wʌn sloʊ ˈbɑdi./
dialogue.zh: 乾木頭、開闊的天、一個慢下來的身體。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow, my shoulders came down twice already.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz keɪm daʊn twaɪs ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 慢了，我的肩膀已經掉下來兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice, is that a number worth keeping?
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz ðæt ə ˈnʌmbər wɜrθ ˈkipɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 兩次，那個數字值得記下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth keeping, I will write it on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrθ ˈkipɪŋ aɪ wɪl raɪt ɪt ɑn ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 值得，我會把它寫在卡片上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write it there, outside, that counts more.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ðɛr ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðæt kaʊnts mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 就在那裡寫，在外頭寫，那更有分量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More, or is that only a nicer word?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ɔr ɪz ðæt ˈoʊnli ə ˈnaɪsər wɜrd?/
dialogue.zh: 更有分量，還是只是好聽一點的說法？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nicer and more true, both at once today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪsər ænd mɔr tru boʊθ æt wʌns təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 好聽也更真，今天兩樣一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At once, the paper makes it simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt wʌns ðə ˈpeɪpər meɪks ɪt ˈsɪmpəl./
dialogue.zh: 一起，有紙在事情就變簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple paper, then walk on toward bread.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl ˈpeɪpər ðɛn wɔk ɑn təˈwɔrd brɛd./
dialogue.zh: 簡單的紙，然後往麵包那邊走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bread, the shop is open past six.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɛd ðə ʃɑp ɪz ˈoʊpən pæst sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 麵包店六點過後還開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six, the smell on the sidewalk is honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ðə smɛl ɑn ðə ˈsaɪdˌwɔk ɪz ˈɑnɪst./
dialogue.zh: 六點，人行道上的味道很真實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honest, and it costs almost nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnɪst ænd ɪt kɔsts ˈɔlmoʊst ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 很真實，而且幾乎不花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost nothing, and you still carry it home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst ˈnʌθɪŋ ænd ju stɪl ˈkæri ɪt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 幾乎不花錢，你還是把它帶回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry it, a loaf is a small weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæri ɪt ə lof ɪz ə smɔl weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 提著它，一條麵包沒多重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small weight, bigger than the file at work.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl weɪt ˈbɪɡər ðæn ðə faɪl æt wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 小小的重量，比公司那個檔案還沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the file stays there, in that room.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə faɪl steɪz ðɛr ɪn ðæt rum./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，檔案留在那裡，在那間房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In that room, not in your hands tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðæt rum nɑt ɪn jɔr hændz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 在那間房裡，不在你的手裡，今晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight I only see my own door.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt aɪ ˈoʊnli si maɪ oʊn dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 今晚我只看見自己那扇門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your own door, and the spare is still safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr oʊn dɔr ænd ðə spɛr ɪz stɪl seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 你自己的門，備用鑰匙也還在老地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keys, bread, card, that is a whole day.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiz brɛd kɑrd ðæt ɪz ə hoʊl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙、麵包、卡片，那就是一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A whole day in three small things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊl deɪ ɪn θri smɔl θɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 一整天就裝在三件小事裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three things, and the walk, that makes four.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri θɪŋz ænd ðə wɔk ðæt meɪks fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 三件事，加上散步，就四件了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four is a full load for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ɪz ə fʊl loʊd fɔr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 四件，對今天已經是滿滿的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full, not empty, I want to keep that word.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl nɑt ˈɛmpi aɪ wɑnt tu kip ðæt wɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 滿的，不是空的，我想留住這個詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it, and let one bus go by.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ænd lɛt wʌn bʌs ɡoʊ baɪ./
dialogue.zh: 留住它，然後放一班公車過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it go, I have the time now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt ɡoʊ aɪ hæv ðə taɪm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 讓它走，我現在有時間了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time, that is the thing we made today.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm ðæt ɪz ðə θɪŋ wi meɪd təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 時間，那是我們今天做出來的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We made it, in fifty minutes, somehow.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi meɪd ɪt ɪn ˈfɪfti ˈmɪnɪts ˈsʌmhaʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們做出了，在五十分鐘裡，不知怎麼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somehow is allowed, it worked in here too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmhaʊ ɪz əˈlaʊd ɪt wɜrkt ɪn hɪr tu./
dialogue.zh: 不知怎麼也可以，在這裡也管用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It worked, my voice feels less flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɜrkt maɪ vɔɪs filz lɛs flæt./
dialogue.zh: 它管用了，我的聲音聽起來不那麼平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less flat, and the jaw came loose too?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs flæt ænd ðə dʒɔ keɪm lus tu?/
dialogue.zh: 比較不平了，下巴也鬆開了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose, I did not know jaws could do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /lus aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ dʒɔz kʊd du ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 鬆開了，我不知道下巴會自己鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Jaws, shoulders, hands, all of them listen.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒɔz ˈʃoʊldərz hændz ɔl əv ðɛm ˈlɪsən./
dialogue.zh: 下巴、肩膀、手，它們都在聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They listened today, they waited eleven days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈlɪsənd təˈdeɪ ðeɪ ˈweɪtəd ɪˈlɛvən deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 它們今天聽了，它們等了十一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the eleven days stop at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ði ɪˈlɛvən deɪz stɑp æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 那十一天就停在門口吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the door, yes, I will close it there.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə dɔr jɛs aɪ wɪl kloʊz ɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 在門口，對，我就在那裡關掉它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close it, then the flat gets quieter.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ɪt ðɛn ðə flæt ɡɛts ˈkwaɪətər./
dialogue.zh: 關掉，然後你的住處會更安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quieter, I will skip the seven show.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪətər aɪ wɪl skɪp ðə ˈsɛvən ʃoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 會更安靜，我跳過七點那集。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not the eight, and the tape plan holds?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ði eɪt ænd ðə teɪp plæn hoʊldz?/
dialogue.zh: 不看八點，那個貼膠帶的計畫還在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Holds, one strip for the line of light.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊldz wʌn strɪp fɔr ðə laɪn əv laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 還在，一條膠帶蓋住門下那道光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One strip, and the dark is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn strɪp ænd ðə dɑrk ɪz jɔrz./
dialogue.zh: 一條膠帶，黑暗就歸你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tired, but walking, that is new tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪərd bʌt ˈwɔkɪŋ ðæt ɪz nju təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 累，可是在走路，今天晚上是新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New tonight, and milk, honey, no phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju təˈnaɪt ænd mɪlk ˈhʌni noʊ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 今晚是新的，牛奶、蜂蜜、不拿手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk, in my own cup, not the blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk ɪn maɪ oʊn kʌp nɑt ðə blu./
dialogue.zh: 牛奶用我自己的杯子，不用那隻藍的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue one waits here until Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu wʌn weɪts hɪr ʌnˈtɪl ˈtuzdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那隻藍的就留在這裡，等下週二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow evening, one line, then the light out.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ˈivnɪŋ wʌn laɪn ðɛn ðə laɪt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 慢的傍晚，寫一行，然後關燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One line before the phone, or after?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn bɪˈfɔr ðə foʊn ɔr ˈæftər?/
dialogue.zh: 那一行寫在手機之前，還是之後？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Before the phone, that is the safer order.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ðə foʊn ðæt ɪz ðə ˈseɪfər ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 在手機之前，那個順序比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safer order, and the three breaths at bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪfər ˈɔrdər ænd ðə θri bɛrθs æt bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 比較安全的順序，然後在床上做三次呼吸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At bed, four in, six out, then dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt bɛd fɔr ɪn sɪks aʊt ðɛn dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 在床上，吸四下，吐六下，然後一片黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the night wakes you at two?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ðə naɪt weɪks ju æt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 如果夜裡兩點把你吵醒呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I breathe three, then I stay in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brið θri ðɛn aɪ steɪ ɪn ðə dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 我呼吸三次，然後留在黑暗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the dark is allowed, that is rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə dɑrk ɪz əˈlaʊd ðæt ɪz rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 留在黑暗裡也可以，那是休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest, not work, the file can wait for Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst nɑt wɜrk ðə faɪl keɪn weɪt fɔr ˈθɜrzdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 是休息，不是工作，那個檔案可以等到週四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The file waits till Thursday, today is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə faɪl weɪts tɪl ˈθɜrzdeɪ təˈdeɪ ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 檔案等到週四就行，今天過完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and I did not finish anything here.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ænd aɪ dɪd nɑt ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈɛniθɪŋ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 過完了，可我在這裡什麼都沒完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not finishing is a kind of finishing.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈfɪnɪʃɪŋ ɪz ə kaɪnd əv ˈfɪnɪʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 沒完成，也算是一種完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That line is for the card, I take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪn ɪz fɔr ðə kɑrd aɪ teɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那一句要寫進卡片，我收下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take it, and the pencil, keep both today.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt ænd ðə ˈpɛnsəl kip boʊθ təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 拿著它，還有鉛筆，今天兩樣都留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both are with me, they ride home with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɑr wɪð mi ðeɪ raɪd hoʊm wɪð mi./
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都在我身上，它們陪我坐車回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home, and the stairs, and one warm room.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm ænd ðə stɛrz ænd wʌn wɔrm rum./
dialogue.zh: 回家，上樓梯，然後一個暖和的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm room, my feet know the walk now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔrm rum maɪ fit noʊ ðə wɔk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 暖和的房間，我的腳現在認得那段路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The walk knows you too, good evening to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔk noʊz ju tu ɡʊd ˈivnɪŋ tu ju./
dialogue.zh: 那段路也認得你，祝你晚間愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To you too, the street lamps are coming on.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ju tu ðə strit læmps ɑr ˈkʌmɪŋ ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 也祝你愉快，街上的燈正在一盞盞亮起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coming on, and the sky still holds the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ ɑn ænd ðə skaɪ stɪl hoʊldz ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一盞盞亮起，天空還留著最後的光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds it, and I will sit at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hoʊldz ɪt ænd aɪ wɪl sɪt æt fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 它留著光，下週四點我會來坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four, room two, and the same slow plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr rum tu ænd ðə seɪm sloʊ plæn./
dialogue.zh: 四點，第二室，還是那個慢慢的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The same plan, and then, the dark at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə seɪm plæn ænd ðɛn ðə dɑrk æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 一樣的計畫，然後，在家裡那片黑。
